<h1 id="content-api-for-shopping">Content API for Shopping v2.1</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Manage your product listings and accounts for Google Shopping

* <a href="https://shoppingcontent.googleapis.com/content/v2.1">https://shoppingcontent.googleapis.com/content/v2.1</a>

# Authentication

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 implicit authentication

    - Flow: implicit
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content|Manage your product listings and accounts for Google Shopping|

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 authorizationCode authentication

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)
    - Token URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content|Manage your product listings and accounts for Google Shopping|

```bash
            "phoneNumber": "string",

          },

            "status": "string"
          },
          "id": "string",
          "kind": "string",
          "labelIds": [
            "string"
          ],
          "name": "string",
```

## content.accounts.credentials.create

<a id="opIdcontent.accounts.credentials.create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/accounts/string/credentials \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "accessToken": "string",
    "expiresIn": "string",
    "purpose": "ACCOUNT_CREDENTIALS_PURPOSE_UNSPECIFIED"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{accountId}/credentials`

Uploads credentials for the Merchant Center account. If credentials already exist for this Merchant Center account and purpose, this method updates them.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accessToken": "string",
  "expiresIn": "string",
  "purpose": "ACCOUNT_CREDENTIALS_PURPOSE_UNSPECIFIED"
}
```

`POST /{merchantId}/orderinvoices/{orderId}/createRefundInvoice`

Creates a refund invoice for one or more shipment groups, and triggers a refund for orderinvoice enabled orders. This can only be used for line items that have previously been charged using `createChargeInvoice`. All amounts (except for the summary) are incremental with respect to the previous invoice.

When false, obtains order returns that have not been acknowledged. When not provided, obtains order returns regardless of their acknowledgement status. We recommend using this filter set to `false`, in conjunction with the `acknowledge` call, such that only un-acknowledged order returns are returned. |
|createdEndDate|query|string|false|Obtains order returns created before this date (inclusively), in ISO 8601 format.|
|createdStartDate|query|string|false|Obtains order returns created after this date (inclusively), in ISO 8601 format.|
|googleOrderIds|query|[string]|false|Obtains order returns with the specified order ids. If this parameter is provided, createdStartDate, createdEndDate, shipmentType, shipmentStatus, shipmentState and acknowledged parameters must be not set. Note: if googleOrderId and shipmentTrackingNumber parameters are provided, the obtained results will include all order returns that either match the specified order id or the specified tracking number.|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|The maximum number of order returns to return in the response, used for paging. The default value is 25 returns per page, and the maximum allowed value is 250 returns per page.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Return the results in the specified order.|
|pageToken|query|string|false|The token returned by the previous request.|
|shipmentStates|query|[string]|false|Obtains order returns that match any shipment state provided in this parameter. When this parameter is not provided, order returns are obtained regardless of their shipment states.|
|shipmentStatus|query|[string]|false|Obtains order returns that match any shipment status provided in this parameter. When this parameter is not provided, order returns are obtained regardless of their shipment statuses.|
|shipmentTrackingNumbers|query|[string]|false|Obtains order returns with the specified tracking numbers. Note: if googleOrderId and shipmentTrackingNumber parameters are provided, the obtained results will include all order returns that either match the specified order id or the specified tracking number.|
|shipmentTypes|query|[string]|false|Obtains order returns that match any shipment type provided in this parameter. When this parameter is not provided, order returns are obtained regardless of their shipment types.|

## content.orderreturns.labels.create

<a id="opIdcontent.orderreturns.labels.create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/string/orderreturns/string/labels \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "carrier": "string",
    "labelUri": "string",
    "trackingId": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /{merchantId}/orderreturns/{returnId}/labels`

Links a return shipping label to a return id. You can only create one return label per return id. Since the label is sent to the buyer, the linked return label cannot be updated or deleted. If you try to create multiple return shipping labels for a single return id, every create request except the first will fail.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "carrier": "string",
  "labelUri": "string",
  "trackingId": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="contentorderslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

When false, obtains orders that have not been acknowledged. We recommend using this filter set to `false`, in conjunction with the `acknowledge` call, such that only un-acknowledged orders are returned. |
|maxResults|query|integer|false|The maximum number of orders to return in the response, used for paging. The default value is 25 orders per page, and the maximum allowed value is 250 orders per page.|

|placedDateEnd|query|string|false|Obtains orders placed before this date (exclusively), in ISO 8601 format.|
|placedDateStart|query|string|false|Obtains orders placed after this date (inclusively), in ISO 8601 format.|
|statuses|query|[string]|false|Obtains orders that match any of the specified statuses. Note that `active` is a shortcut for `pendingShipment` and `partiallyShipped`, and `completed` is a shortcut for `shipped`, `partiallyDelivered`, `delivered`, `partiallyReturned`, `returned`, and `canceled`.|

```bash
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{}'
```

`POST /{merchantId}/orders/{orderId}/captureOrder`

Capture funds from the customer for the current order total. This method should be called after the merchant verifies that they are able and ready to start shipping the order. This method blocks until a response is received from the payment processsor. If this method succeeds, the merchant is guaranteed to receive funds for the order after shipment. If the request fails, it can be retried or the order may be cancelled. This method cannot be called after the entire order is already shipped. A rejected error code is returned when the payment service provider has declined the charge. This indicates a problem between the PSP and either the merchant's or customer's account. Sometimes this error will be resolved by the customer. We recommend retrying these errors once per day or cancelling the order with reason `failedToCaptureFunds` if the items cannot be held.

> Body parameter

```json
{}
```

`POST /{merchantId}/orders/{orderId}/inStoreRefundLineItem`

Deprecated. Notifies that item return and refund was handled directly by merchant outside of Google payments processing (for example, cash refund done in store). Note: We recommend calling the returnrefundlineitem method to refund in-store returns. We will issue the refund directly to the customer. This helps to prevent possible differences arising between merchant and Google transaction records. We also recommend having the point of sale system communicate with Google to ensure that customers do not receive a double refund by first refunding through Google then through an in-store return.

`POST /{merchantId}/orders/{orderId}/returnRefundLineItem`

Returns and refunds a line item. Note that this method can only be called on fully shipped orders. The Orderreturns API is the preferred way to handle returns after you receive a return from a customer. You can use Orderreturns.list or Orderreturns.get to search for the return, and then use Orderreturns.processreturn to issue the refund. If the return cannot be found, then we recommend using this API to issue a refund.

```json
  "operationId": "string",

    "value": "string"
```

`POST /{merchantId}/orders/{orderId}/setLineItemMetadata`

Sets (or overrides if it already exists) merchant provided annotations in the form of key-value pairs. A common use case would be to supply us with additional structured information about a line item that cannot be provided through other methods. Submitted key-value pairs can be retrieved as part of the orders resource.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "annotations": [
    {
      "key": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "lineItemId": "string",
  "operationId": "string",
  "productId": "string"
}
```

## content.products.list

<a id="opIdcontent.products.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/string/products \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /{merchantId}/products`

Lists the products in your Merchant Center account. The response might contain fewer items than specified by maxResults. Rely on nextPageToken to determine if there are more items to be requested.

<h3 id="contentproductslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchantId|path|string|true|The ID of the account that contains the products. This account cannot be a multi-client account.|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|The maximum number of products to return in the response, used for paging.|
|pageToken|query|string|false|The token returned by the previous request.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
Oauth2 ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content ) & Oauth2c ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content )
</aside>

`POST /{merchantId}/products`

Uploads a product to your Merchant Center account. If an item with the same channel, contentLanguage, offerId, and targetCountry already exists, this method updates that entry.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchantId|path|string|true|The ID of the account that contains the product. This account cannot be a multi-client account.|
|feedId|query|string|false|The Content API Supplemental Feed ID. If present then product insertion applies to the data in a supplemental feed.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[Product](#schemaproduct)|false|none|
|» additionalImageLinks|body|[string]|false|Additional URLs of images of the item.|
|» additionalSizeType|body|string|false|Additional cut of the item. Used together with size_type to represent combined size types for apparel items.|
|» adsGrouping|body|string|false|Used to group items in an arbitrary way. Only for CPA%, discouraged otherwise.|
|» adsLabels|body|[string]|false|Similar to ads_grouping, but only works on CPC.|
|» adsRedirect|body|string|false|Allows advertisers to override the item URL when the product is shown within the context of Product Ads.|
|» adult|body|boolean|false|Should be set to true if the item is targeted towards adults.|
|» ageGroup|body|string|false|Target age group of the item.|
|» availability|body|string|false|Availability status of the item.|
|» availabilityDate|body|string|false|The day a pre-ordered product becomes available for delivery, in ISO 8601 format.|
|» brand|body|string|false|Brand of the item.|
|» canonicalLink|body|string|false|URL for the canonical version of your item's landing page.|
|» channel|body|string|false|Required. The item's channel (online or local). Acceptable values are: - "`local`" - "`online`" |
|» color|body|string|false|Color of the item.|
|» condition|body|string|false|Condition or state of the item.|
|» contentLanguage|body|string|false|Required. The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the item.|
|» costOfGoodsSold|body|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|Cost of goods sold. Used for gross profit reporting.|
|» customAttributes|body|[[CustomAttribute](#schemacustomattribute)]|false|A list of custom (merchant-provided) attributes. It can also be used for submitting any attribute of the feed specification in its generic form (for example, `{ "name": "size type", "value": "regular" }`). This is useful for submitting attributes not explicitly exposed by the API, such as additional attributes used for Buy on Google (formerly known as Shopping Actions).|
|» customLabel0|body|string|false|Custom label 0 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel1|body|string|false|Custom label 1 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel2|body|string|false|Custom label 2 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel3|body|string|false|Custom label 3 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» customLabel4|body|string|false|Custom label 4 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the item.|
|» displayAdsId|body|string|false|An identifier for an item for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» displayAdsLink|body|string|false|URL directly to your item's landing page for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» displayAdsSimilarIds|body|[string]|false|Advertiser-specified recommendations.|
|» displayAdsTitle|body|string|false|Title of an item for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» displayAdsValue|body|number(double)|false|Offer margin for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|» energyEfficiencyClass|body|string|false|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU.|
|» excludedDestinations|body|[string]|false|The list of destinations to exclude for this target (corresponds to cleared check boxes in Merchant Center). Products that are excluded from all destinations for more than 7 days are automatically deleted.|
|» expirationDate|body|string|false|Date on which the item should expire, as specified upon insertion, in ISO 8601 format. The actual expiration date in Google Shopping is exposed in `productstatuses` as `googleExpirationDate` and might be earlier if `expirationDate` is too far in the future.|
|» externalSellerId|body|string|false|Required for multi-seller accounts. Use this attribute if you're a marketplace uploading products for various sellers to your multi-seller account.|
|» feedLabel|body|string|false|Feed label for the item. Either `targetCountry` or `feedLabel` is required. Must be less than or equal to 20 uppercase letters (A-Z), numbers (0-9), and dashes (-).|
|» gender|body|string|false|Target gender of the item.|
|» googleProductCategory|body|string|false|Google's category of the item (see [Google product taxonomy](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/1705911)). When querying products, this field will contain the user provided value. There is currently no way to get back the auto assigned google product categories through the API.|
|» gtin|body|string|false|Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) of the item.|
|» id|body|string|false|The REST ID of the product. Content API methods that operate on products take this as their `productId` parameter. The REST ID for a product has one of the 2 forms channel:contentLanguage: targetCountry: offerId or channel:contentLanguage:feedLabel: offerId.|
|» identifierExists|body|boolean|false|False when the item does not have unique product identifiers appropriate to its category, such as GTIN, MPN, and brand. Required according to the Unique Product Identifier Rules for all target countries except for Canada.|
|» imageLink|body|string|false|URL of an image of the item.|
|» includedDestinations|body|[string]|false|The list of destinations to include for this target (corresponds to checked check boxes in Merchant Center). Default destinations are always included unless provided in `excludedDestinations`.|
|» installment|body|[Installment](#schemainstallment)|false|Number and amount of installments to pay for an item.|
|» isBundle|body|boolean|false|Whether the item is a merchant-defined bundle. A bundle is a custom grouping of different products sold by a merchant for a single price.|
|» itemGroupId|body|string|false|Shared identifier for all variants of the same product.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#product`"|
|» lifestyleImageLinks|body|[string]|false|Additional URLs of lifestyle images of the item. Used to explicitly identify images that showcase your item in a real-world context. See the Help Center article for more information.|
|» link|body|string|false|URL directly linking to your item's page on your website.|
|» linkTemplate|body|string|false|URL template for merchant hosted local storefront.|
|» loyaltyPoints|body|[LoyaltyPoints](#schemaloyaltypoints)|false|Loyalty points that users receive after purchasing the item. Japan only.|
|» material|body|string|false|The material of which the item is made.|
|» maxEnergyEfficiencyClass|body|string|false|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU.|
|» maxHandlingTime|body|string(int64)|false|Maximal product handling time (in business days).|
|» minEnergyEfficiencyClass|body|string|false|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU.|
|» minHandlingTime|body|string(int64)|false|Minimal product handling time (in business days).|
|» mobileLink|body|string|false|URL for the mobile-optimized version of your item's landing page.|
|» mobileLinkTemplate|body|string|false|URL template for merchant hosted local storefront optimized for mobile devices.|
|» mpn|body|string|false|Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the item.|
|» multipack|body|string(int64)|false|The number of identical products in a merchant-defined multipack.|
|» offerId|body|string|false|Required. A unique identifier for the item. Leading and trailing whitespaces are stripped and multiple whitespaces are replaced by a single whitespace upon submission. Only valid unicode characters are accepted. See the products feed specification for details. *Note:* Content API methods that operate on products take the REST ID of the product, *not* this identifier.|
|» pattern|body|string|false|The item's pattern (for example, polka dots).|
|» pause|body|string|false|Publication of this item should be temporarily paused. Acceptable values are: - "`ads`" |
|» pickupMethod|body|string|false|The pick up option for the item. Acceptable values are: - "`buy`" - "`reserve`" - "`ship to store`" - "`not supported`" |
|» pickupSla|body|string|false|Item store pickup timeline. Acceptable values are: - "`same day`" - "`next day`" - "`2-day`" - "`3-day`" - "`4-day`" - "`5-day`" - "`6-day`" - "`7-day`" - "`multi-week`" |
|» price|body|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|Price of the item.|
|» productDetails|body|[[ProductProductDetail](#schemaproductproductdetail)]|false|Technical specification or additional product details.|
|» productHeight|body|[ProductDimension](#schemaproductdimension)|false|The height of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 3000 (inclusive).|
|» productHighlights|body|[string]|false|Bullet points describing the most relevant highlights of a product.|
|» productLength|body|[ProductDimension](#schemaproductdimension)|false|The length of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 3000 (inclusive).|
|» productTypes|body|[string]|false|Categories of the item (formatted as in product data specification).|
|» productWeight|body|[ProductWeight](#schemaproductweight)|false|The weight of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 2000 (inclusive).|
|» productWidth|body|[ProductDimension](#schemaproductdimension)|false|The width of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 3000 (inclusive).|
|» promotionIds|body|[string]|false|The unique ID of a promotion.|
|» salePrice|body|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|Advertised sale price of the item.|
|» salePriceEffectiveDate|body|string|false|Date range during which the item is on sale (see product data specification ).|
|» sellOnGoogleQuantity|body|string(int64)|false|The quantity of the product that is available for selling on Google. Supported only for online products.|
|» shipping|body|[[ProductShipping](#schemaproductshipping)]|false|Shipping rules.|
|» shippingHeight|body|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|Height of the item for shipping.|
|» shippingLabel|body|string|false|The shipping label of the product, used to group product in account-level shipping rules.|
|» shippingLength|body|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|Length of the item for shipping.|
|» shippingWeight|body|[ProductShippingWeight](#schemaproductshippingweight)|false|Weight of the item for shipping.|
|» shippingWidth|body|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|Width of the item for shipping.|
|» shoppingAdsExcludedCountries|body|[string]|false|List of country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) to exclude the offer from Shopping Ads destination. Countries from this list are removed from countries configured in MC feed settings.|
|» sizeSystem|body|string|false|System in which the size is specified. Recommended for apparel items.|
|» sizeType|body|string|false|The cut of the item. Recommended for apparel items.|
|» sizes|body|[string]|false|Size of the item. Only one value is allowed. For variants with different sizes, insert a separate product for each size with the same `itemGroupId` value (see size definition).|
|» source|body|string|false|The source of the offer, that is, how the offer was created. Acceptable values are: - "`api`" - "`crawl`" - "`feed`" |
|» subscriptionCost|body|[ProductSubscriptionCost](#schemaproductsubscriptioncost)|false|Number of periods (months or years) and amount of payment per period for an item with an associated subscription contract.|
|» targetCountry|body|string|false|Required. The CLDR territory code for the item's country of sale.|
|» taxCategory|body|string|false|The tax category of the product, used to configure detailed tax nexus in account-level tax settings.|
|» taxes|body|[[ProductTax](#schemaproducttax)]|false|Tax information.|
|» title|body|string|false|Title of the item.|
|» transitTimeLabel|body|string|false|The transit time label of the product, used to group product in account-level transit time tables.|
|» unitPricingBaseMeasure|body|[ProductUnitPricingBaseMeasure](#schemaproductunitpricingbasemeasure)|false|The preference of the denominator of the unit price.|
|» unitPricingMeasure|body|[ProductUnitPricingMeasure](#schemaproductunitpricingmeasure)|false|The measure and dimension of an item.|

## content.productstatuses.custombatch

<a id="opIdcontent.productstatuses.custombatch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/productstatuses/batch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "entries": [
      {
        "batchId": 0,
        "destinations": [
          "string"
        ],
        "includeAttributes": true,
        "merchantId": "string",
        "method": "string",
        "productId": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /productstatuses/batch`

Gets the statuses of multiple products in a single request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "batchId": 0,
      "destinations": [
        "string"
      ],
      "includeAttributes": true,
      "merchantId": "string",
      "method": "string",
      "productId": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

|endDate|query|string|false|Gets Repricing reports on and before this date in the merchant's timezone. You can only retrieve data up to 7 days ago (default) or earlier. Format is YYYY-MM-DD.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Maximum number of days of reports to return. There can be more than one rule report returned per day. For example, if 3 rule types got applied to the same product within a 24-hour period, then a page_size of 1 will return 3 rule reports. The page size defaults to 50 and values above 1000 are coerced to 1000. This service may return fewer days of reports than this value, for example, if the time between your start and end date is less than the page size.|
|pageToken|query|string|false|Token (if provided) to retrieve the subsequent page. All other parameters must match the original call that provided the page token.|
|ruleId|query|string|false|Id of the Repricing rule. If specified, only gets this rule's reports.|
|startDate|query|string|false|Gets Repricing reports on and after this date in the merchant's timezone, up to one year ago. Do not use a start date later than 7 days ago (default). Format is YYYY-MM-DD.|

`POST /{merchantId}/promotions`

Inserts a promotion for your Merchant Center account. If the promotion already exists, then it updates the promotion instead. To [end or delete] (https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/promotions#end_a_promotion) a promotion update the time period of the promotion to a time that has already passed.

Account data. After the creation of a new account it may take a few minutes before it's fully operational. The methods delete, insert, and update require the admin role.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountManagement|string|false|read-only|Output only. How the account is managed. Acceptable values are: - "`manual`" - "`automatic`" |
|adsLinks|[[AccountAdsLink](#schemaaccountadslink)]|false|none|Linked Ads accounts that are active or pending approval. To create a new link request, add a new link with status `active` to the list. It will remain in a `pending` state until approved or rejected either in the Ads interface or through the Google Ads API. To delete an active link, or to cancel a link request, remove it from the list.|

To create a new link request, add a new link with status `active` to the list. It will remain in a `pending` state until approved or rejected in the YT Creator Studio interface. To delete an active link, or to cancel a link request, remove it from the list.|


|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|adsId|string(uint64)|false|none|Customer ID of the Ads account.|
|status|string|false|none|Status of the link between this Merchant Center account and the Ads account. Upon retrieval, it represents the actual status of the link and can be either `active` if it was approved in Google Ads or `pending` if it's pending approval. Upon insertion, it represents the *intended* status of the link. Re-uploading a link with status `active` when it's still pending or with status `pending` when it's already active will have no effect: the status will remain unchanged. Re-uploading a link with deprecated status `inactive` is equivalent to not submitting the link at all and will delete the link if it was active or cancel the link request if it was pending. Acceptable values are: - "`active`" - "`pending`" |


Turning on [item updates](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/3246284) allows Google to automatically update items for you. When item updates are on, Google uses the structured data markup on the website and advanced data extractors to update the price and availability of the items. When the item updates are off, items with mismatched data aren't shown.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountItemUpdatesSettings|[AccountItemUpdatesSettings](#schemaaccountitemupdatessettings)|false|none|Determines which attributes of the items should be automatically updated. If this field is not present, then the settings will be deleted. If there are no settings for subaccount, they are inherited from aggregator.|
|effectiveAllowAvailabilityUpdates|boolean|false|read-only|Output only. The effective value of allow_availability_updates. If account_item_updates_settings is present, then this value is the same. Otherwise, it represents the inherited value of the parent account. Read-only.|
|effectiveAllowConditionUpdates|boolean|false|read-only|Output only. The effective value of allow_condition_updates. If account_item_updates_settings is present, then this value is the same. Otherwise, it represents the inherited value of the parent account. Read-only.|
|effectiveAllowPriceUpdates|boolean|false|read-only|Output only. The effective value of allow_price_updates. If account_item_updates_settings is present, then this value is the same. Otherwise, it represents the inherited value of the parent account. Read-only.|
|effectiveAllowStrictAvailabilityUpdates|boolean|false|read-only|Output only. The effective value of allow_strict_availability_updates. If account_item_updates_settings is present, then this value is the same. Otherwise, it represents the inherited value of the parent account. Read-only.|

If additionally `allow_availability_updates` field is set to true, values get overwritten if Google finds an in-stock annotation on the offer’s page.|
|allowConditionUpdates|boolean|false|none|If condition updates are enabled, Google always updates item condition with the condition detected from the details of your product.|
|allowPriceUpdates|boolean|false|none|If price updates are enabled, Google always updates the active price with the crawled information.|
|allowStrictAvailabilityUpdates|boolean|false|none|If allow_availability_updates is enabled, items are automatically updated in all your Shopping target countries. By default, availability updates will only be applied to items that are 'out of stock' on your website but 'in stock' on Shopping. Set this to true to also update items that are 'in stock' on your website, but 'out of stock' on Google Shopping. In order for this field to have an effect, you must also allow availability updates.|

```json
{
  "channelId": "string",
  "status": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|string|false|none|Channel ID.|
|status|string|false|none|Status of the link between this Merchant Center account and the YouTube channel. Upon retrieval, it represents the actual status of the link and can be either `active` if it was approved in YT Creator Studio or `pending` if it's pending approval. Upon insertion, it represents the *intended* status of the link. Re-uploading a link with status `active` when it's still pending or with status `pending` when it's already active will have no effect: the status will remain unchanged. Re-uploading a link with deprecated status `inactive` is equivalent to not submitting the link at all and will delete the link if it was active or cancel the link request if it was pending.|

<h2 id="tocS_BestSellers">BestSellers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabestsellers"></a>
<a id="schema_BestSellers"></a>
<a id="tocSbestsellers"></a>
<a id="tocsbestsellers"></a>

```json
{
  "categoryId": "string",
  "countryCode": "string",
  "previousRank": "string",
  "previousRelativeDemand": "RELATIVE_DEMAND_UNSPECIFIED",
  "rank": "string",
  "relativeDemand": "RELATIVE_DEMAND_UNSPECIFIED",
  "relativeDemandChange": "RELATIVE_DEMAND_CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "reportDate": {
    "day": 0,
    "month": 0,
    "year": 0
  },
  "reportGranularity": "REPORT_GRANULARITY_UNSPECIFIED"
}
```

Fields related to the [Best sellers reports](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9488679).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|categoryId|string(int64)|false|none|Google product category ID to calculate the ranking for, represented in [Google's product taxonomy](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324436). If a `WHERE` condition on `best_sellers.category_id` is not specified in the query, rankings for all top-level categories are returned.|
|countryCode|string|false|none|Country where the ranking is calculated. A `WHERE` condition on `best_sellers.country_code` is required in the query.|
|previousRank|string(int64)|false|none|Popularity rank in the previous week or month.|
|previousRelativeDemand|string|false|none|Estimated demand in relation to the item with the highest popularity rank in the same category and country in the previous week or month.|
|rank|string(int64)|false|none|Popularity on Shopping ads and free listings, in the selected category and country, based on the estimated number of units sold.|
|relativeDemand|string|false|none|Estimated demand in relation to the item with the highest popularity rank in the same category and country.|
|relativeDemandChange|string|false|none|Change in the estimated demand. Whether it rose, sank or remained flat.|
|reportDate|[Date](#schemadate)|false|none|Report date. The value of this field can only be one of the following: * The first day of the week (Monday) for weekly reports. * The first day of the month for monthly reports. If a `WHERE` condition on `best_sellers.report_date` is not specified in the query, the latest available weekly or monthly report is returned.|
|reportGranularity|string|false|none|Granularity of the report. The ranking can be done over a week or a month timeframe. A `WHERE` condition on `best_sellers.report_granularity` is required in the query.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|name|string|false|none|Name of the carrier rate. Must be unique per rate group. Required.|
|originPostalCode|string|false|none|Shipping origin for this carrier rate. Required.|
|percentageAdjustment|string|false|none|Multiplicative shipping rate modifier as a number in decimal notation. Can be negative. For example `"5.4"` increases the rate by 5.4%, `"-3"` decreases the rate by 3%. Optional.|

<h2 id="tocS_DatafeedFetchSchedule">DatafeedFetchSchedule</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadatafeedfetchschedule"></a>
<a id="schema_DatafeedFetchSchedule"></a>
<a id="tocSdatafeedfetchschedule"></a>
<a id="tocsdatafeedfetchschedule"></a>

```json
{
  "dayOfMonth": 0,
  "fetchUrl": "string",
  "hour": 0,
  "minuteOfHour": 0,
  "password": "string",
  "paused": true,
  "timeZone": "string",
  "username": "string",
  "weekday": "string"
}
```

The required fields vary based on the frequency of fetching. For a monthly fetch schedule, day_of_month and hour are required. For a weekly fetch schedule, weekday and hour are required. For a daily fetch schedule, only hour is required.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|dayOfMonth|integer(uint32)|false|none|The day of the month the feed file should be fetched (1-31).|
|fetchUrl|string|false|none|The URL where the feed file can be fetched. Google Merchant Center will support automatic scheduled uploads using the HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, or SFTP protocols, so the value will need to be a valid link using one of those four protocols.|
|hour|integer(uint32)|false|none|The hour of the day the feed file should be fetched (0-23).|
|minuteOfHour|integer(uint32)|false|none|The minute of the hour the feed file should be fetched (0-59). Read-only.|
|password|string|false|none|An optional password for fetch_url.|
|paused|boolean|false|none|Whether the scheduled fetch is paused or not.|
|timeZone|string|false|none|Time zone used for schedule. UTC by default. For example, "America/Los_Angeles".|
|username|string|false|none|An optional user name for fetch_url.|
|weekday|string|false|none|The day of the week the feed file should be fetched. Acceptable values are: - "`monday`" - "`tuesday`" - "`wednesday`" - "`thursday`" - "`friday`" - "`saturday`" - "`sunday`" |

<h2 id="tocS_DatafeedFormat">DatafeedFormat</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadatafeedformat"></a>
<a id="schema_DatafeedFormat"></a>
<a id="tocSdatafeedformat"></a>
<a id="tocsdatafeedformat"></a>

```json
{
  "columnDelimiter": "string",
  "fileEncoding": "string",
  "quotingMode": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|columnDelimiter|string|false|none|Delimiter for the separation of values in a delimiter-separated values feed. If not specified, the delimiter will be auto-detected. Ignored for non-DSV data feeds. Acceptable values are: - "`pipe`" - "`tab`" - "`tilde`" |
|fileEncoding|string|false|none|Character encoding scheme of the data feed. If not specified, the encoding will be auto-detected. Acceptable values are: - "`latin-1`" - "`utf-16be`" - "`utf-16le`" - "`utf-8`" - "`windows-1252`" |
|quotingMode|string|false|none|Specifies how double quotes are interpreted. If not specified, the mode will be auto-detected. Ignored for non-DSV data feeds. Acceptable values are: - "`normal character`" - "`value quoting`" |

<h2 id="tocS_DatafeedStatus">DatafeedStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadatafeedstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_DatafeedStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSdatafeedstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsdatafeedstatus"></a>

```json
{
  "country": "string",
  "datafeedId": "string",
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "count": "string",
      "examples": [
        {
          "itemId": "string",
          "lineNumber": "string",
          "value": "string"
        }
      ],
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "feedLabel": "string",
  "itemsTotal": "string",
  "itemsValid": "string",
  "kind": "string",
  "language": "string",
  "lastUploadDate": "string",
  "processingStatus": "string",
  "warnings": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "count": "string",
      "examples": [
        {
          "itemId": "string",
          "lineNumber": "string",
          "value": "string"
        }
      ],
      "message": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

The status of a datafeed, that is, the result of the last retrieval of the datafeed computed asynchronously when the feed processing is finished.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|country|string|false|none|The country for which the status is reported, represented as a CLDR territory code.|
|datafeedId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the feed for which the status is reported.|
|errors|[[DatafeedStatusError](#schemadatafeedstatuserror)]|false|none|The list of errors occurring in the feed.|
|feedLabel|string|false|none|The feed label status is reported for.|
|itemsTotal|string(uint64)|false|none|The number of items in the feed that were processed.|
|itemsValid|string(uint64)|false|none|The number of items in the feed that were valid.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#datafeedStatus`"|
|language|string|false|none|The two-letter ISO 639-1 language for which the status is reported.|
|lastUploadDate|string|false|none|The last date at which the feed was uploaded.|
|processingStatus|string|false|none|The processing status of the feed. Acceptable values are: - "`"`failure`": The feed could not be processed or all items had errors.`" - "`in progress`": The feed is being processed. - "`none`": The feed has not yet been processed. For example, a feed that has never been uploaded will have this processing status. - "`success`": The feed was processed successfully, though some items might have had errors. |
|warnings|[[DatafeedStatusError](#schemadatafeedstatuserror)]|false|none|The list of errors occurring in the feed.|

|examples|[[DatafeedStatusExample](#schemadatafeedstatusexample)]|false|none|A list of example occurrences of the error, grouped by product.|
|message|string|false|none|The error message, for example, "Invalid price".|

<h2 id="tocS_DatafeedTarget">DatafeedTarget</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadatafeedtarget"></a>
<a id="schema_DatafeedTarget"></a>
<a id="tocSdatafeedtarget"></a>
<a id="tocsdatafeedtarget"></a>

```json
{
  "country": "string",
  "excludedDestinations": [
    "string"
  ],
  "feedLabel": "string",
  "includedDestinations": [
    "string"
  ],
  "language": "string",
  "targetCountries": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|country|string|false|none|Deprecated. Use `feedLabel` instead. The country where the items in the feed will be included in the search index, represented as a CLDR territory code.|
|excludedDestinations|[string]|false|none|The list of destinations to exclude for this target (corresponds to cleared check boxes in Merchant Center). Products that are excluded from all destinations for more than 7 days are automatically deleted.|
|feedLabel|string|false|none|Feed label for the DatafeedTarget. Either `country` or `feedLabel` is required. If both `feedLabel` and `country` is specified, the values must match. Must be less than or equal to 20 uppercase letters (A-Z), numbers (0-9), and dashes (-).|
|includedDestinations|[string]|false|none|The list of destinations to include for this target (corresponds to checked check boxes in Merchant Center). Default destinations are always included unless provided in `excludedDestinations`.|
|language|string|false|none|The two-letter ISO 639-1 language of the items in the feed. Must be a valid language for `targets[].country`.|
|targetCountries|[string]|false|none|The countries where the items may be displayed. Represented as a CLDR territory code. Will be ignored for "product inventory" feeds.|

<h2 id="tocS_Date">Date</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadate"></a>
<a id="schema_Date"></a>
<a id="tocSdate"></a>
<a id="tocsdate"></a>

```json
{
  "day": 0,
  "month": 0,
  "year": 0
}
```

Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the following: * A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values. * A month and day, with a zero year (for example, an anniversary). * A year on its own, with a zero month and a zero day. * A year and month, with a zero day (for example, a credit card expiration date). Related types: * google.type.TimeOfDay * google.type.DateTime * google.protobuf.Timestamp

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|day|integer(int32)|false|none|Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0 to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't significant.|
|month|integer(int32)|false|none|Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a month and day.|
|year|integer(int32)|false|none|Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without a year.|

<h2 id="tocS_DateTime">DateTime</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadatetime"></a>
<a id="schema_DateTime"></a>
<a id="tocSdatetime"></a>
<a id="tocsdatetime"></a>

```json
{
  "day": 0,
  "hours": 0,
  "minutes": 0,
  "month": 0,
  "nanos": 0,
  "seconds": 0,
  "timeZone": {
    "id": "string",
    "version": "string"
  },
  "utcOffset": "string",
  "year": 0
}
```

Represents civil time (or occasionally physical time). This type can represent a civil time in one of a few possible ways: * When utc_offset is set and time_zone is unset: a civil time on a calendar day with a particular offset from UTC. * When time_zone is set and utc_offset is unset: a civil time on a calendar day in a particular time zone. * When neither time_zone nor utc_offset is set: a civil time on a calendar day in local time. The date is relative to the Proleptic Gregorian Calendar. If year, month, or day are 0, the DateTime is considered not to have a specific year, month, or day respectively. This type may also be used to represent a physical time if all the date and time fields are set and either case of the `time_offset` oneof is set. Consider using `Timestamp` message for physical time instead. If your use case also would like to store the user's timezone, that can be done in another field. This type is more flexible than some applications may want. Make sure to document and validate your application's limitations.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|day|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Day of month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0 if specifying a datetime without a day.|
|hours|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Hours of day in 24 hour format. Should be from 0 to 23, defaults to 0 (midnight). An API may choose to allow the value "24:00:00" for scenarios like business closing time.|
|minutes|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Minutes of hour of day. Must be from 0 to 59, defaults to 0.|
|month|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Month of year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 if specifying a datetime without a month.|
|nanos|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Fractions of seconds in nanoseconds. Must be from 0 to 999,999,999, defaults to 0.|
|seconds|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Seconds of minutes of the time. Must normally be from 0 to 59, defaults to 0. An API may allow the value 60 if it allows leap-seconds.|
|timeZone|[TimeZone](#schematimezone)|false|none|Time zone.|
|utcOffset|string(google-duration)|false|none|UTC offset. Must be whole seconds, between -18 hours and +18 hours. For example, a UTC offset of -4:00 would be represented as { seconds: -14400 }.|
|year|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. Year of date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 if specifying a datetime without a year.|

### Properties

|postalCodeRange|[DeliveryAreaPostalCodeRange](#schemadeliveryareapostalcoderange)|false|none|A postal code, postal code range or postal code prefix that defines this area. Limited to US and AUS.|
|regionCode|string|false|none|A state, territory, or prefecture. This is supported for the United States, Australia, and Japan. Provide a subdivision code from the ISO 3166-2 code tables ([US](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2:US), [AU](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2:AU), or [JP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2:JP)) without country prefix (for example, `"NY"`, `"NSW"`, `"03"`).|

<h2 id="tocS_DeliveryAreaPostalCodeRange">DeliveryAreaPostalCodeRange</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

```json
{
  "firstPostalCode": "string",
  "lastPostalCode": "string"
}
```

A range of postal codes that defines the delivery area. Only set `firstPostalCode` when specifying a single postal code.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|firstPostalCode|string|false|none|Required. A postal code or a pattern of the form prefix* denoting the inclusive lower bound of the range defining the area. Examples values: `"94108"`, `"9410*"`, `"9*"`.|
|lastPostalCode|string|false|none|A postal code or a pattern of the form prefix* denoting the inclusive upper bound of the range defining the area (for example [070* - 078*] results in the range [07000 - 07899]). It must have the same length as `firstPostalCode`: if `firstPostalCode` is a postal code then `lastPostalCode` must be a postal code too; if firstPostalCode is a pattern then `lastPostalCode` must be a pattern with the same prefix length. Ignored if not set, then the area is defined as being all the postal codes matching `firstPostalCode`.|

|numberOfItems|[string]|false|none|A list of inclusive number of items upper bounds. The last value can be `"infinity"`. For example `["10", "50", "infinity"]` represents the headers "<= 10 items", "<= 50 items", and "> 50 items". Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|postalCodeGroupNames|[string]|false|none|A list of postal group names. The last value can be `"all other locations"`. Example: `["zone 1", "zone 2", "all other locations"]`. The referred postal code groups must match the delivery country of the service. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|prices|[[Price](#schemaprice)]|false|none|A list of inclusive order price upper bounds. The last price's value can be `"infinity"`. For example `[{"value": "10", "currency": "USD"}, {"value": "500", "currency": "USD"}, {"value": "infinity", "currency": "USD"}]` represents the headers "<= $10", "<= $500", and "> $500". All prices within a service must have the same currency. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|weights|[[Weight](#schemaweight)]|false|none|A list of inclusive order weight upper bounds. The last weight's value can be `"infinity"`. For example `[{"value": "10", "unit": "kg"}, {"value": "50", "unit": "kg"}, {"value": "infinity", "unit": "kg"}]` represents the headers "<= 10kg", "<= 50kg", and "> 50kg". All weights within a service must have the same unit. Must be non-empty. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|

<h2 id="tocS_HolidayCutoff">HolidayCutoff</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocsholidaycutoff"></a>

```json
{

  "deadlineTimezone": "string",
  "holidayId": "string",
  "visibleFromDate": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|deadlineDate|string|false|none|Date of the order deadline, in ISO 8601 format. For example, "2016-11-29" for 29th November 2016. Required.|
|deadlineHour|integer(uint32)|false|none|Hour of the day on the deadline date until which the order has to be placed to qualify for the delivery guarantee. Possible values are: 0 (midnight), 1, ..., 12 (noon), 13, ..., 23. Required.|
|deadlineTimezone|string|false|none|Timezone identifier for the deadline hour (for example, "Europe/Zurich"). List of identifiers. Required.|
|holidayId|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the holiday. Required.|
|visibleFromDate|string|false|none|Date on which the deadline will become visible to consumers in ISO 8601 format. For example, "2016-10-31" for 31st October 2016. Required.|

<h2 id="tocS_HolidaysHoliday">HolidaysHoliday</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaholidaysholiday"></a>
<a id="schema_HolidaysHoliday"></a>
<a id="tocSholidaysholiday"></a>
<a id="tocsholidaysholiday"></a>

```json
{
  "countryCode": "string",
  "date": "string",
  "deliveryGuaranteeDate": "string",
  "deliveryGuaranteeHour": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "type": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|countryCode|string|false|none|The CLDR territory code of the country in which the holiday is available. For example, "US", "DE", "GB". A holiday cutoff can only be configured in a shipping settings service with matching delivery country. Always present.|
|date|string|false|none|Date of the holiday, in ISO 8601 format. For example, "2016-12-25" for Christmas 2016. Always present.|
|deliveryGuaranteeDate|string|false|none|Date on which the order has to arrive at the customer's, in ISO 8601 format. For example, "2016-12-24" for 24th December 2016. Always present.|
|deliveryGuaranteeHour|string(uint64)|false|none|Hour of the day in the delivery location's timezone on the guaranteed delivery date by which the order has to arrive at the customer's. Possible values are: 0 (midnight), 1, ..., 12 (noon), 13, ..., 23. Always present.|
|id|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the holiday to be used when configuring holiday cutoffs. Always present.|
|type|string|false|none|The holiday type. Always present. Acceptable values are: - "`Christmas`" - "`Easter`" - "`Father's Day`" - "`Halloween`" - "`Independence Day (USA)`" - "`Mother's Day`" - "`Thanksgiving`" - "`Valentine's Day`" |

<h2 id="tocS_LocalInventory">LocalInventory</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemalocalinventory"></a>
<a id="schema_LocalInventory"></a>
<a id="tocSlocalinventory"></a>
<a id="tocslocalinventory"></a>

```json
{
  "availability": "string",
  "customAttributes": [
    {
      "groupValues": [
        {}
      ],
      "name": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "instoreProductLocation": "string",
  "kind": "string",
  "pickupMethod": "string",
  "pickupSla": "string",
  "price": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "quantity": 0,
  "salePrice": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "salePriceEffectiveDate": "string",
  "storeCode": "string"
}
```

Local inventory resource. For accepted attribute values, see the local product inventory feed specification.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|availability|string|false|none|Availability of the product. For accepted attribute values, see the local product inventory feed specification.|
|customAttributes|[[CustomAttribute](#schemacustomattribute)]|false|none|A list of custom (merchant-provided) attributes. Can also be used to submit any attribute of the feed specification in its generic form, for example, `{ "name": "size type", "value": "regular" }`.|
|instoreProductLocation|string|false|none|In-store product location.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#localInventory`"|
|pickupMethod|string|false|none|Supported pickup method for this offer. Unless the value is "not supported", this field must be submitted together with `pickupSla`. For accepted attribute values, see the local product inventory feed specification.|
|pickupSla|string|false|none|Expected date that an order will be ready for pickup relative to the order date. Must be submitted together with `pickupMethod`. For accepted attribute values, see the local product inventory feed specification.|
|price|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Price of the product.|
|quantity|integer(uint32)|false|none|Quantity of the product. Must be nonnegative.|
|salePrice|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Sale price of the product. Mandatory if `sale_price_effective_date` is defined.|
|salePriceEffectiveDate|string|false|none|A date range represented by a pair of ISO 8601 dates separated by a space, comma, or slash. Both dates may be specified as 'null' if undecided.|
|storeCode|string|false|none|Required. Store code of this local inventory resource.|

Performance metrics. Values are only set for metrics requested explicitly in the request's search query.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|aos|number(double)|false|none|Average order size - the average number of items in an order. **This metric cannot be segmented by product dimensions and customer_country_code.**|
|aovMicros|number(double)|false|none|Average order value in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros) - the average value (total price of items) of all placed orders. The currency of the returned value is stored in the currency_code segment. If this metric is selected, 'segments.currency_code' is automatically added to the SELECT clause in the search query (unless it is explicitly selected by the user) and the currency_code segment is populated in the response. **This metric cannot be segmented by product dimensions and customer_country_code.**|
|clicks|string(int64)|false|none|Number of clicks.|
|conversionRate|number(double)|false|none|Number of conversions divided by the number of clicks, reported on the impression date. The metric is currently available only for the FREE_PRODUCT_LISTING program.|
|conversionValueMicros|string(int64)|false|none|Value of conversions in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros) attributed to the product, reported on the conversion date. The metric is currently available only for the FREE_PRODUCT_LISTING program. The currency of the returned value is stored in the currency_code segment. If this metric is selected, 'segments.currency_code' is automatically added to the SELECT clause in the search query (unless it is explicitly selected by the user) and the currency_code segment is populated in the response.|
|conversions|number(double)|false|none|Number of conversions attributed to the product, reported on the conversion date. Depending on the attribution model, a conversion might be distributed across multiple clicks, where each click gets its own credit assigned. This metric is a sum of all such credits. The metric is currently available only for the FREE_PRODUCT_LISTING program.|
|ctr|number(double)|false|none|Click-through rate - the number of clicks merchant's products receive (clicks) divided by the number of times the products are shown (impressions).|
|daysToShip|number(double)|false|none|Average number of days between an order being placed and the order being fully shipped, reported on the last shipment date. **This metric cannot be segmented by product dimensions and customer_country_code.**|
|impressions|string(int64)|false|none|Number of times merchant's products are shown.|
|itemDaysToShip|number(double)|false|none|Average number of days between an item being ordered and the item being **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|itemFillRate|number(double)|false|none|Percentage of shipped items in relation to all finalized items (shipped or rejected by the merchant; unshipped items are not taken into account), reported on the order date. Item fill rate is lowered by merchant rejections. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|orderedItemSalesMicros|string(int64)|false|none|Total price of ordered items in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros). Excludes shipping, taxes (US only), and customer cancellations that happened within 30 minutes of placing the order. The currency of the returned value is stored in the currency_code segment. If this metric is selected, 'segments.currency_code' is automatically added to the SELECT clause in the search query (unless it is explicitly selected by the user) and the currency_code segment is populated in the response. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|orderedItems|string(int64)|false|none|Number of ordered items. Excludes customer cancellations that happened within 30 minutes of placing the order. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|orders|string(int64)|false|none|Number of placed orders. Excludes customer cancellations that happened within 30 minutes of placing the order. **This metric cannot be segmented by product dimensions and customer_country_code.**|
|rejectedItems|string(int64)|false|none|Number of ordered items canceled by the merchant, reported on the order date. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|returnRate|number(double)|false|none|Total price of returned items divided by the total price of shipped items, reported on the order date. If this metric is selected, 'segments.currency_code' is automatically added to the SELECT clause in the search query (unless it is explicitly selected by the user) and the currency_code segment is populated in the response. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|returnedItems|string(int64)|false|none|Number of ordered items sent back for return, reported on the date when the merchant accepted the return. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|returnsMicros|string(int64)|false|none|Total price of ordered items sent back for return in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros), reported on the date when the merchant accepted the return. The currency of the returned value is stored in the currency_code segment. If this metric is selected, 'segments.currency_code' is automatically added to the SELECT clause in the search query (unless it is explicitly selected by the user) and the currency_code segment is populated in the response. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|shippedItemSalesMicros|string(int64)|false|none|Total price of shipped items in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros), reported on the order date. Excludes shipping and taxes (US only). The currency of the returned value is stored in the currency_code segment. If this metric is selected, 'segments.currency_code' is automatically added to the SELECT clause in the search query (unless it is explicitly selected by the user) and the currency_code segment is populated in the response. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|shippedItems|string(int64)|false|none|Number of shipped items, reported on the shipment date. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|shippedOrders|string(int64)|false|none|Number of fully shipped orders, reported on the last shipment date. **This metric cannot be segmented by product dimensions and customer_country_code.**|
|unshippedItems|number(double)|false|none|Number of ordered items not shipped up until the end of the queried day. If a multi-day period is specified in the search query, the returned value is the average number of unshipped items over the days in the queried period. **This metric cannot be segmented by customer_country_code.**|
|unshippedOrders|number(double)|false|none|Number of orders not shipped or partially shipped up until the end of the queried day. If a multi-day period is specified in the search query, the returned value is the average number of unshipped orders over the days in the queried period. **This metric cannot be segmented by product dimensions and customer_country_code.**|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acknowledged|boolean|false|none|Whether the order was acknowledged.|
|annotations|[[OrderOrderAnnotation](#schemaorderorderannotation)]|false|none|List of key-value pairs that are attached to a given order.|
|billingAddress|[OrderAddress](#schemaorderaddress)|false|none|The billing address.|
|customer|[OrderCustomer](#schemaordercustomer)|false|none|The details of the customer who placed the order.|
|deliveryDetails|[OrderDeliveryDetails](#schemaorderdeliverydetails)|false|none|Delivery details for shipments of type `delivery`.|
|id|string|false|none|The REST ID of the order. Globally unique.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#order`"|
|lineItems|[[OrderLineItem](#schemaorderlineitem)]|false|none|Line items that are ordered.|
|merchantId|string(uint64)|false|none|none|
|merchantOrderId|string|false|none|Merchant-provided ID of the order.|
|netPriceAmount|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The net amount for the order (price part). For example, if an order was originally for $100 and a refund was issued for $20, the net amount will be $80.|
|netTaxAmount|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The net amount for the order (tax part). Note that in certain cases due to taxable base adjustment `netTaxAmount` might not match to a sum of tax field across all lineItems and refunds.|
|paymentStatus|string|false|none|The status of the payment. Acceptable values are: - "`paymentCaptured`" - "`paymentRejected`" - "`paymentSecured`" - "`pendingAuthorization`" |
|pickupDetails|[OrderPickupDetails](#schemaorderpickupdetails)|false|none|Pickup details for shipments of type `pickup`.|
|placedDate|string|false|none|The date when the order was placed, in ISO 8601 format.|
|promotions|[[OrderPromotion](#schemaorderpromotion)]|false|none|Promotions associated with the order. To determine which promotions apply to which products, check the `Promotions[].appliedItems[].lineItemId` field against the `LineItems[].id` field for each promotion. If a promotion is applied to more than 1 offerId, divide the discount value by the number of affected offers to determine how much discount to apply to each offerId. Examples: 1. To calculate price paid by the customer for a single line item including the discount: For each promotion, subtract the `LineItems[].adjustments[].priceAdjustment.value` amount from the `LineItems[].Price.value`. 2. To calculate price paid by the customer for a single line item including the discount in case of multiple quantity: For each promotion, divide the `LineItems[].adjustments[].priceAdjustment.value` by the quantity of products then subtract the resulting value from the `LineItems[].Product.Price.value` for each quantity item. Only 1 promotion can be applied to an offerId in a given order. To refund an item which had a promotion applied to it, make sure to refund the amount after first subtracting the promotion discount from the item price. More details about the program are here.|
|refunds|[[OrderRefund](#schemaorderrefund)]|false|none|Refunds for the order.|
|shipments|[[OrderShipment](#schemaordershipment)]|false|none|Shipments of the order.|
|shippingCost|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The total cost of shipping for all items.|
|shippingCostTax|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The tax for the total shipping cost.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the order. Acceptable values are: - "`canceled`" - "`delivered`" - "`inProgress`" - "`partiallyDelivered`" - "`partiallyReturned`" - "`partiallyShipped`" - "`pendingShipment`" - "`returned`" - "`shipped`" |
|taxCollector|string|false|none|The party responsible for collecting and remitting taxes. Acceptable values are: - "`marketplaceFacilitator`" - "`merchant`" |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicableItems|[[OrderPromotionItem](#schemaorderpromotionitem)]|false|none|Items that this promotion may be applied to. If empty, there are no restrictions on applicable items and quantity. This field will also be empty for shipping promotions because shipping is not tied to any specific item.|
|appliedItems|[[OrderPromotionItem](#schemaorderpromotionitem)]|false|none|Items that this promotion have been applied to. Do not provide for `orders.createtestorder`. This field will be empty for shipping promotions because shipping is not tied to any specific item.|
|endTime|string|false|none|Promotion end time in ISO 8601 format. Date, time, and offset required, for example, "2020-01-02T09:00:00+01:00" or "2020-01-02T09:00:00Z".|
|funder|string|false|none|Required. The party funding the promotion. Only `merchant` is supported for `orders.createtestorder`. Acceptable values are: - "`google`" - "`merchant`" |
|merchantPromotionId|string|false|none|Required. This field is used to identify promotions within merchants' own systems.|
|priceValue|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Estimated discount applied to price. Amount is pre-tax or post-tax depending on location of order.|
|shortTitle|string|false|none|A short title of the promotion to be shown on the checkout page. Do not provide for `orders.createtestorder`.|
|startTime|string|false|none|Promotion start time in ISO 8601 format. Date, time, and offset required, for example, "2020-01-02T09:00:00+01:00" or "2020-01-02T09:00:00Z".|
|subtype|string|false|none|Required. The category of the promotion. Only `moneyOff` is supported for `orders.createtestorder`. Acceptable values are: - "`buyMGetMoneyOff`" - "`buyMGetNMoneyOff`" - "`buyMGetNPercentOff`" - "`buyMGetPercentOff`" - "`freeGift`" - "`freeGiftWithItemId`" - "`freeGiftWithValue`" - "`freeShippingOvernight`" - "`freeShippingStandard`" - "`freeShippingTwoDay`" - "`moneyOff`" - "`percentOff`" - "`rewardPoints`" - "`salePrice`" |
|taxValue|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Estimated discount applied to tax (if allowed by law). Do not provide for `orders.createtestorder`.|
|title|string|false|none|Required. The title of the promotion.|
|type|string|false|none|Required. The scope of the promotion. Only `product` is supported for `orders.createtestorder`. Acceptable values are: - "`product`" - "`shipping`" |

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|carrier|string|false|none|The carrier handling the shipment. For supported carriers, Google includes the carrier name and tracking URL in emails to customers. For select supported carriers, Google also automatically updates the shipment status based on the provided shipment ID. *Note:* You can also use unsupported carriers, but emails to customers won't include the carrier name or tracking URL, and there will be no automatic order status updates. Supported carriers for "US" are: - "`ups`" (United Parcel Service) *automatic status updates* - "`usps`" (United States Postal Service) *automatic status updates* - "`fedex`" (FedEx) *automatic status updates * - "`dhl`" (DHL eCommerce) *automatic status updates* (US only) - "`ontrac`" (OnTrac) *automatic status updates * - "`dhl express`" (DHL Express) - "`deliv`" (Deliv) - "`dynamex`" (TForce) - "`lasership`" (LaserShip) - "`mpx`" (Military Parcel Xpress) - "`uds`" (United Delivery Service) - "`efw`" (Estes Forwarding Worldwide) - "`jd logistics`" (JD Logistics) - "`yunexpress`" (YunExpress) - "`china post`" (China Post) - "`china ems`" (China Post Express Mail Service) - "`singapore post`" (Singapore Post) - "`pos malaysia`" (Pos Malaysia) - "`postnl`" (PostNL) - "`ptt`" (PTT Turkish Post) - "`eub`" (ePacket) - "`chukou1`" (Chukou1 Logistics) - "`bestex`" (Best Express) - "`canada post`" (Canada Post) - "`purolator`" (Purolator) - "`canpar`" (Canpar) - "`india post`" (India Post) - "`blue dart`" (Blue Dart) - "`delhivery`" (Delhivery) - "`dtdc`" (DTDC) - "`tpc india`" (TPC India) - "`lso`" (Lone Star Overnight) - "`tww`" (Team Worldwide) - "`deliver-it`" (Deliver-IT) - "`cdl last mile`" (CDL Last Mile) Supported carriers for FR are: - "`la poste`" (La Poste) *automatic status updates * - "`colissimo`" (Colissimo by La Poste) *automatic status updates* - "`ups`" (United Parcel Service) *automatic status updates * - "`chronopost`" (Chronopost by La Poste) - "`gls`" (General Logistics Systems France) - "`dpd`" (DPD Group by GeoPost) - "`bpost`" (Belgian Post Group) - "`colis prive`" (Colis Privé) - "`boxtal`" (Boxtal) - "`geodis`" (GEODIS) - "`tnt`" (TNT) - "`db schenker`" (DB Schenker) - "`aramex`" (Aramex) |
|creationDate|string|false|none|Date on which the shipment has been created, in ISO 8601 format.|
|deliveryDate|string|false|none|Date on which the shipment has been delivered, in ISO 8601 format. Present only if `status` is `delivered`|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the shipment.|
|lineItems|[[OrderShipmentLineItemShipment](#schemaordershipmentlineitemshipment)]|false|none|The line items that are shipped.|
|scheduledDeliveryDetails|[OrderShipmentScheduledDeliveryDetails](#schemaordershipmentscheduleddeliverydetails)|false|none|Delivery details of the shipment if scheduling is needed.|
|shipmentGroupId|string|false|none|The shipment group ID of the shipment. This is set in shiplineitems request.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the shipment. Acceptable values are: - "`delivered`" - "`readyForPickup`" - "`shipped`" - "`undeliverable`" |
|trackingId|string|false|none|The tracking ID for the shipment.|

Represents a merchant trade from which signals are extracted, e.g. shipping.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerShippingFee|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|The shipping fee of the order; this value should be set to zero in the case of free shipping.|
|deliveryPostalCode|string|false|none|Required. The delivery postal code, as a continuous string without spaces or dashes, e.g. "95016". This field will be anonymized in returned OrderTrackingSignal creation response.|
|deliveryRegionCode|string|false|none|Required. The [CLDR territory code] (http://www.unicode.org/repos/cldr/tags/latest/common/main/en.xml) for the shipping destination.|
|lineItems|[[OrderTrackingSignalLineItemDetails](#schemaordertrackingsignallineitemdetails)]|false|none|Information about line items in the order.|
|merchantId|string(int64)|false|none|The Google merchant ID of this order tracking signal. This value is optional. If left unset, the caller's merchant ID is used. You must request access in order to provide data on behalf of another merchant. For more information, see [Submitting Order Tracking Signals](/shopping-content/guides/order-tracking-signals).|
|orderCreatedTime|[DateTime](#schemadatetime)|false|none|Required. The time when the order was created on the merchant side. Include the year and timezone string, if available.|
|orderId|string|false|none|Required. The ID of the order on the merchant side. This field will be hashed in returned OrderTrackingSignal creation response.|
|orderTrackingSignalId|string(int64)|false|read-only|Output only. The ID that uniquely identifies this order tracking signal.|
|shipmentLineItemMapping|[[OrderTrackingSignalShipmentLineItemMapping](#schemaordertrackingsignalshipmentlineitemmapping)]|false|none|The mapping of the line items to the shipment information.|
|shippingInfo|[[OrderTrackingSignalShippingInfo](#schemaordertrackingsignalshippinginfo)]|false|none|The shipping information for the order.|

The shipping information for the order.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actualDeliveryTime|[DateTime](#schemadatetime)|false|none|The time when the shipment was actually delivered. Include the year and timezone string, if available. This field is required, if one of the following fields is absent: tracking_id or carrier_name.|
|carrierName|string|false|none|The name of the shipping carrier for the delivery. This field is required if one of the following fields is absent: earliest_delivery_promise_time, latest_delivery_promise_time, and actual_delivery_time.|
|carrierServiceName|string|false|none|The service type for fulfillment, e.g., GROUND, FIRST_CLASS, etc.|
|earliestDeliveryPromiseTime|[DateTime](#schemadatetime)|false|none|The earliest delivery promised time. Include the year and timezone string, if available. This field is required, if one of the following fields is absent: tracking_id or carrier_name.|
|latestDeliveryPromiseTime|[DateTime](#schemadatetime)|false|none|The latest delivery promised time. Include the year and timezone string, if available. This field is required, if one of the following fields is absent: tracking_id or carrier_name.|
|originPostalCode|string|false|none|The origin postal code, as a continuous string without spaces or dashes, e.g. "95016". This field will be anonymized in returned OrderTrackingSignal creation response.|
|originRegionCode|string|false|none|The [CLDR territory code] (http://www.unicode.org/repos/cldr/tags/latest/common/main/en.xml) for the shipping origin.|
|shipmentId|string|false|none|Required. The shipment ID. This field will be hashed in returned OrderTrackingSignal creation response.|
|shippedTime|[DateTime](#schemadatetime)|false|none|The time when the shipment was shipped. Include the year and timezone string, if available.|
|shippingStatus|string|false|none|The status of the shipment.|
|trackingId|string|false|none|The tracking ID of the shipment. This field is required if one of the following fields is absent: earliest_delivery_promise_time, latest_delivery_promise_time, and actual_delivery_time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|shippingStatus|SHIPPING_STATE_UNSPECIFIED|
|shippingStatus|SHIPPED|
|shippingStatus|DELIVERED|

<a id="schemapostalcodegroup"></a>
<a id="schema_PostalCodeGroup"></a>
<a id="tocSpostalcodegroup"></a>
<a id="tocspostalcodegroup"></a>

```json
{
  "country": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "postalCodeRanges": [
    {
      "postalCodeRangeBegin": "string",
      "postalCodeRangeEnd": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|country|string|false|none|The CLDR territory code of the country the postal code group applies to. Required.|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the postal code group, referred to in headers. Required.|
|postalCodeRanges|[[PostalCodeRange](#schemapostalcoderange)]|false|none|A range of postal codes. Required.|

<h2 id="tocS_PostalCodeRange">PostalCodeRange</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostalcoderange"></a>
<a id="schema_PostalCodeRange"></a>
<a id="tocSpostalcoderange"></a>
<a id="tocspostalcoderange"></a>

```json
{
  "postalCodeRangeBegin": "string",
  "postalCodeRangeEnd": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|postalCodeRangeBegin|string|false|none|A postal code or a pattern of the form `prefix*` denoting the inclusive lower bound of the range defining the area. Examples values: `"94108"`, `"9410*"`, `"9*"`. Required.|
|postalCodeRangeEnd|string|false|none|A postal code or a pattern of the form `prefix*` denoting the inclusive upper bound of the range defining the area. It must have the same length as `postalCodeRangeBegin`: if `postalCodeRangeBegin` is a postal code then `postalCodeRangeEnd` must be a postal code too; if `postalCodeRangeBegin` is a pattern then `postalCodeRangeEnd` must be a pattern with the same prefix length. Optional: if not set, then the area is defined as being all the postal codes matching `postalCodeRangeBegin`.|
