<h2 id="tocS_PriceCompetitiveness">PriceCompetitiveness</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapricecompetitiveness"></a>
<a id="schema_PriceCompetitiveness"></a>
<a id="tocSpricecompetitiveness"></a>
<a id="tocspricecompetitiveness"></a>

```json
{
  "benchmarkPriceCurrencyCode": "string",
  "benchmarkPriceMicros": "string",
  "countryCode": "string"
}
```

Price competitiveness fields requested by the merchant in the query. Field values are only set if the merchant queries `PriceCompetitivenessProductView`. https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9626903

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|benchmarkPriceCurrencyCode|string|false|none|The price benchmark currency (ISO 4217 code).|
|benchmarkPriceMicros|string(int64)|false|none|The latest available price benchmark in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros) for the product's catalog in the benchmark country.|
|countryCode|string|false|none|The country of the price benchmark (ISO 3166 code).|

<h2 id="tocS_PriceInsights">PriceInsights</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapriceinsights"></a>
<a id="schema_PriceInsights"></a>
<a id="tocSpriceinsights"></a>
<a id="tocspriceinsights"></a>

```json
{
  "predictedClicksChangeFraction": 0,
  "predictedConversionsChangeFraction": 0,
  "predictedGrossProfitChangeFraction": 0,
  "predictedImpressionsChangeFraction": 0,
  "predictedMonthlyGrossProfitChangeCurrencyCode": "string",
  "predictedMonthlyGrossProfitChangeMicros": "string",
  "suggestedPriceCurrencyCode": "string",
  "suggestedPriceMicros": "string"
}
```

Price insights fields requested by the merchant in the query. Field values are only set if the merchant queries `PriceInsightsProductView`. https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/11916926

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|predictedClicksChangeFraction|number(double)|false|none|The predicted change in clicks as a fraction after introducing the suggested price compared to current active price. For example, 0.05 is a 5% predicted increase in clicks.|
|predictedConversionsChangeFraction|number(double)|false|none|The predicted change in conversions as a fraction after introducing the suggested price compared to current active price. For example, 0.05 is a 5% predicted increase in conversions).|
|predictedGrossProfitChangeFraction|number(double)|false|none|The predicted change in gross profit as a fraction after introducing the suggested price compared to current active price. For example, 0.05 is a 5% predicted increase in gross profit.|
|predictedImpressionsChangeFraction|number(double)|false|none|The predicted change in impressions as a fraction after introducing the suggested price compared to current active price. For example, 0.05 is a 5% predicted increase in impressions.|
|predictedMonthlyGrossProfitChangeCurrencyCode|string|false|none|The predicted monthly gross profit change currency (ISO 4217 code).|
|predictedMonthlyGrossProfitChangeMicros|string(int64)|false|none|The predicted change in gross profit in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros) after introducing the suggested price for a month compared to current active price.|
|suggestedPriceCurrencyCode|string|false|none|The suggested price currency (ISO 4217 code).|
|suggestedPriceMicros|string(int64)|false|none|The latest suggested price in micros (1 millionth of a standard unit, 1 USD = 1000000 micros) for the product.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additionalImageLinks|[string]|false|none|Additional URLs of images of the item.|
|additionalSizeType|string|false|none|Additional cut of the item. Used together with size_type to represent combined size types for apparel items.|
|adsGrouping|string|false|none|Used to group items in an arbitrary way. Only for CPA%, discouraged otherwise.|
|adsLabels|[string]|false|none|Similar to ads_grouping, but only works on CPC.|
|adsRedirect|string|false|none|Allows advertisers to override the item URL when the product is shown within the context of Product Ads.|
|adult|boolean|false|none|Should be set to true if the item is targeted towards adults.|
|ageGroup|string|false|none|Target age group of the item.|
|availability|string|false|none|Availability status of the item.|
|availabilityDate|string|false|none|The day a pre-ordered product becomes available for delivery, in ISO 8601 format.|
|brand|string|false|none|Brand of the item.|
|canonicalLink|string|false|none|URL for the canonical version of your item's landing page.|
|channel|string|false|none|Required. The item's channel (online or local). Acceptable values are: - "`local`" - "`online`" |
|color|string|false|none|Color of the item.|
|condition|string|false|none|Condition or state of the item.|
|contentLanguage|string|false|none|Required. The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the item.|
|costOfGoodsSold|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Cost of goods sold. Used for gross profit reporting.|
|customAttributes|[[CustomAttribute](#schemacustomattribute)]|false|none|A list of custom (merchant-provided) attributes. It can also be used for submitting any attribute of the feed specification in its generic form (for example, `{ "name": "size type", "value": "regular" }`). This is useful for submitting attributes not explicitly exposed by the API, such as additional attributes used for Buy on Google (formerly known as Shopping Actions).|
|customLabel0|string|false|none|Custom label 0 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|customLabel1|string|false|none|Custom label 1 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|customLabel2|string|false|none|Custom label 2 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|customLabel3|string|false|none|Custom label 3 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|customLabel4|string|false|none|Custom label 4 for custom grouping of items in a Shopping campaign.|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the item.|
|displayAdsId|string|false|none|An identifier for an item for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|displayAdsLink|string|false|none|URL directly to your item's landing page for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|displayAdsSimilarIds|[string]|false|none|Advertiser-specified recommendations.|
|displayAdsTitle|string|false|none|Title of an item for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|displayAdsValue|number(double)|false|none|Offer margin for dynamic remarketing campaigns.|
|energyEfficiencyClass|string|false|none|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU.|
|excludedDestinations|[string]|false|none|The list of destinations to exclude for this target (corresponds to cleared check boxes in Merchant Center). Products that are excluded from all destinations for more than 7 days are automatically deleted.|
|expirationDate|string|false|none|Date on which the item should expire, as specified upon insertion, in ISO 8601 format. The actual expiration date in Google Shopping is exposed in `productstatuses` as `googleExpirationDate` and might be earlier if `expirationDate` is too far in the future.|
|externalSellerId|string|false|none|Required for multi-seller accounts. Use this attribute if you're a marketplace uploading products for various sellers to your multi-seller account.|
|feedLabel|string|false|none|Feed label for the item. Either `targetCountry` or `feedLabel` is required. Must be less than or equal to 20 uppercase letters (A-Z), numbers (0-9), and dashes (-).|
|gender|string|false|none|Target gender of the item.|
|googleProductCategory|string|false|none|Google's category of the item (see [Google product taxonomy](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/1705911)). When querying products, this field will contain the user provided value. There is currently no way to get back the auto assigned google product categories through the API.|
|gtin|string|false|none|Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) of the item.|
|id|string|false|none|The REST ID of the product. Content API methods that operate on products take this as their `productId` parameter. The REST ID for a product has one of the 2 forms channel:contentLanguage: targetCountry: offerId or channel:contentLanguage:feedLabel: offerId.|
|identifierExists|boolean|false|none|False when the item does not have unique product identifiers appropriate to its category, such as GTIN, MPN, and brand. Required according to the Unique Product Identifier Rules for all target countries except for Canada.|
|imageLink|string|false|none|URL of an image of the item.|
|includedDestinations|[string]|false|none|The list of destinations to include for this target (corresponds to checked check boxes in Merchant Center). Default destinations are always included unless provided in `excludedDestinations`.|
|installment|[Installment](#schemainstallment)|false|none|Number and amount of installments to pay for an item.|
|isBundle|boolean|false|none|Whether the item is a merchant-defined bundle. A bundle is a custom grouping of different products sold by a merchant for a single price.|
|itemGroupId|string|false|none|Shared identifier for all variants of the same product.|
|kind|string|false|none|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "`content#product`"|
|lifestyleImageLinks|[string]|false|none|Additional URLs of lifestyle images of the item. Used to explicitly identify images that showcase your item in a real-world context. See the Help Center article for more information.|
|link|string|false|none|URL directly linking to your item's page on your website.|
|linkTemplate|string|false|none|URL template for merchant hosted local storefront.|
|loyaltyPoints|[LoyaltyPoints](#schemaloyaltypoints)|false|none|Loyalty points that users receive after purchasing the item. Japan only.|
|material|string|false|none|The material of which the item is made.|
|maxEnergyEfficiencyClass|string|false|none|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU.|
|maxHandlingTime|string(int64)|false|none|Maximal product handling time (in business days).|
|minEnergyEfficiencyClass|string|false|none|The energy efficiency class as defined in EU directive 2010/30/EU.|
|minHandlingTime|string(int64)|false|none|Minimal product handling time (in business days).|
|mobileLink|string|false|none|URL for the mobile-optimized version of your item's landing page.|
|mobileLinkTemplate|string|false|none|URL template for merchant hosted local storefront optimized for mobile devices.|
|mpn|string|false|none|Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the item.|
|multipack|string(int64)|false|none|The number of identical products in a merchant-defined multipack.|
|offerId|string|false|none|Required. A unique identifier for the item. Leading and trailing whitespaces are stripped and multiple whitespaces are replaced by a single whitespace upon submission. Only valid unicode characters are accepted. See the products feed specification for details. *Note:* Content API methods that operate on products take the REST ID of the product, *not* this identifier.|
|pattern|string|false|none|The item's pattern (for example, polka dots).|
|pause|string|false|none|Publication of this item should be temporarily paused. Acceptable values are: - "`ads`" |
|pickupMethod|string|false|none|The pick up option for the item. Acceptable values are: - "`buy`" - "`reserve`" - "`ship to store`" - "`not supported`" |
|pickupSla|string|false|none|Item store pickup timeline. Acceptable values are: - "`same day`" - "`next day`" - "`2-day`" - "`3-day`" - "`4-day`" - "`5-day`" - "`6-day`" - "`7-day`" - "`multi-week`" |
|price|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Price of the item.|
|productDetails|[[ProductProductDetail](#schemaproductproductdetail)]|false|none|Technical specification or additional product details.|
|productHeight|[ProductDimension](#schemaproductdimension)|false|none|The height of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 3000 (inclusive).|
|productHighlights|[string]|false|none|Bullet points describing the most relevant highlights of a product.|
|productLength|[ProductDimension](#schemaproductdimension)|false|none|The length of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 3000 (inclusive).|
|productTypes|[string]|false|none|Categories of the item (formatted as in product data specification).|
|productWeight|[ProductWeight](#schemaproductweight)|false|none|The weight of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 2000 (inclusive).|
|productWidth|[ProductDimension](#schemaproductdimension)|false|none|The width of the product in the units provided. The value must be between 0 (exclusive) and 3000 (inclusive).|
|promotionIds|[string]|false|none|The unique ID of a promotion.|
|salePrice|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Advertised sale price of the item.|
|salePriceEffectiveDate|string|false|none|Date range during which the item is on sale (see product data specification ).|
|sellOnGoogleQuantity|string(int64)|false|none|The quantity of the product that is available for selling on Google. Supported only for online products.|
|shipping|[[ProductShipping](#schemaproductshipping)]|false|none|Shipping rules.|
|shippingHeight|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|none|Height of the item for shipping.|
|shippingLabel|string|false|none|The shipping label of the product, used to group product in account-level shipping rules.|
|shippingLength|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|none|Length of the item for shipping.|
|shippingWeight|[ProductShippingWeight](#schemaproductshippingweight)|false|none|Weight of the item for shipping.|
|shippingWidth|[ProductShippingDimension](#schemaproductshippingdimension)|false|none|Width of the item for shipping.|
|shoppingAdsExcludedCountries|[string]|false|none|List of country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) to exclude the offer from Shopping Ads destination. Countries from this list are removed from countries configured in MC feed settings.|
|sizeSystem|string|false|none|System in which the size is specified. Recommended for apparel items.|
|sizeType|string|false|none|The cut of the item. Recommended for apparel items.|
|sizes|[string]|false|none|Size of the item. Only one value is allowed. For variants with different sizes, insert a separate product for each size with the same `itemGroupId` value (see size definition).|
|source|string|false|none|The source of the offer, that is, how the offer was created. Acceptable values are: - "`api`" - "`crawl`" - "`feed`" |
|subscriptionCost|[ProductSubscriptionCost](#schemaproductsubscriptioncost)|false|none|Number of periods (months or years) and amount of payment per period for an item with an associated subscription contract.|
|targetCountry|string|false|none|Required. The CLDR territory code for the item's country of sale.|
|taxCategory|string|false|none|The tax category of the product, used to configure detailed tax nexus in account-level tax settings.|
|taxes|[[ProductTax](#schemaproducttax)]|false|none|Tax information.|
|title|string|false|none|Title of the item.|
|transitTimeLabel|string|false|none|The transit time label of the product, used to group product in account-level transit time tables.|
|unitPricingBaseMeasure|[ProductUnitPricingBaseMeasure](#schemaproductunitpricingbasemeasure)|false|none|The preference of the denominator of the unit price.|
|unitPricingMeasure|[ProductUnitPricingMeasure](#schemaproductunitpricingmeasure)|false|none|The measure and dimension of an item.|

<h2 id="tocS_ProductCluster">ProductCluster</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaproductcluster"></a>
<a id="schema_ProductCluster"></a>
<a id="tocSproductcluster"></a>
<a id="tocsproductcluster"></a>

```json
{
  "brand": "string",
  "brandInventoryStatus": "INVENTORY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED",
  "categoryL1": "string",
  "categoryL2": "string",
  "categoryL3": "string",
  "categoryL4": "string",
  "categoryL5": "string",
  "inventoryStatus": "INVENTORY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED",
  "title": "string",
  "variantGtins": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

Product cluster fields. A product cluster is a grouping for different offers that represent the same product. Values are only set for fields requested explicitly in the request's search query.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|brand|string|false|none|Brand of the product cluster.|
|brandInventoryStatus|string|false|none|Tells if there is at least one product of the brand currently `IN_STOCK` in your product feed across multiple countries, all products are `OUT_OF_STOCK` in your product feed, or `NOT_IN_INVENTORY`. The field doesn't take the Best Sellers report country filter into account.|
|categoryL1|string|false|none|Product category (1st level) of the product cluster, represented in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL2|string|false|none|Product category (2nd level) of the product cluster, represented in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL3|string|false|none|Product category (3rd level) of the product cluster, represented in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL4|string|false|none|Product category (4th level) of the product cluster, represented in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL5|string|false|none|Product category (5th level) of the product cluster, represented in Google's product taxonomy.|
|inventoryStatus|string|false|none|Tells whether the product cluster is `IN_STOCK` in your product feed across multiple countries, `OUT_OF_STOCK` in your product feed, or `NOT_IN_INVENTORY` at all. The field doesn't take the Best Sellers report country filter into account.|
|title|string|false|none|Title of the product cluster.|
|variantGtins|[string]|false|none|GTINs of example variants of the product cluster.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|brandInventoryStatus|INVENTORY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED|
|brandInventoryStatus|IN_STOCK|
|brandInventoryStatus|OUT_OF_STOCK|
|brandInventoryStatus|NOT_IN_INVENTORY|
|inventoryStatus|INVENTORY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED|
|inventoryStatus|IN_STOCK|

The estimated days to deliver a product after an order is placed. Only authorized shipping signals partners working with a merchant can use this resource. Merchants should use the [`products`](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/reference/rest/v2.1/products#productshipping) resource instead.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|areaDeliveryTimes|[[ProductDeliveryTimeAreaDeliveryTime](#schemaproductdeliverytimeareadeliverytime)]|false|none|Required. A set of associations between `DeliveryArea` and `DeliveryTime` entries. The total number of `areaDeliveryTimes` can be at most 100.|
|productId|[ProductId](#schemaproductid)|false|none|Required. The `id` of the product.|

```json
{
  "country": "string",
  "locationGroupName": "string",
  "locationId": "string",
  "maxHandlingTime": "string",
  "maxTransitTime": "string",
  "minHandlingTime": "string",
  "minTransitTime": "string",
  "postalCode": "string",
  "price": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "region": "string",
  "service": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|country|string|false|none|The CLDR territory code of the country to which an item will ship.|
|locationGroupName|string|false|none|The location where the shipping is applicable, represented by a location group name.|
|locationId|string(int64)|false|none|The numeric ID of a location that the shipping rate applies to as defined in the Google Ads API.|
|maxHandlingTime|string(int64)|false|none|Maximum handling time (inclusive) between when the order is received and shipped in business days. 0 means that the order is shipped on the same day as it's received if it happens before the cut-off time. Both maxHandlingTime and maxTransitTime are required if providing shipping speeds.|
|maxTransitTime|string(int64)|false|none|Maximum transit time (inclusive) between when the order has shipped and when it's delivered in business days. 0 means that the order is delivered on the same day as it ships. Both maxHandlingTime and maxTransitTime are required if providing shipping speeds.|
|minHandlingTime|string(int64)|false|none|Minimum handling time (inclusive) between when the order is received and shipped in business days. 0 means that the order is shipped on the same day as it's received if it happens before the cut-off time. minHandlingTime can only be present together with maxHandlingTime; but it's not required if maxHandlingTime is present.|
|minTransitTime|string(int64)|false|none|Minimum transit time (inclusive) between when the order has shipped and when it's delivered in business days. 0 means that the order is delivered on the same day as it ships. minTransitTime can only be present together with maxTransitTime; but it's not required if maxTransitTime is present.|
|postalCode|string|false|none|The postal code range that the shipping rate applies to, represented by a postal code, a postal code prefix followed by a * wildcard, a range between two postal codes or two postal code prefixes of equal length.|
|price|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Fixed shipping price, represented as a number.|
|region|string|false|none|The geographic region to which a shipping rate applies.|
|service|string|false|none|A free-form description of the service class or delivery speed.|

A batch entry encoding a single non-batch products request.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|batchId|integer(uint32)|false|none|An entry ID, unique within the batch request.|
|feedId|string(uint64)|false|none|The Content API Supplemental Feed ID. If present then product insertion or deletion applies to a supplemental feed instead of primary Content API feed.|
|merchantId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the managing account.|
|method|string|false|none|The method of the batch entry. Acceptable values are: - "`delete`" - "`get`" - "`insert`" - "`update`" |
|product|[Product](#schemaproduct)|false|none|The product to insert or update. Only required if the method is `insert` or `update`. If the `update` method is used with `updateMask` only to delete a field, then this isn't required. For example, setting `salePrice` on the `updateMask` and not providing a `product` will result in an existing sale price on the product specified by `productId` being deleted.|
|productId|string|false|none|The ID of the product to get or mutate. Only defined if the method is `get`, `delete`, or `update`.|
|updateMask|string(google-fieldmask)|false|none|The comma-separated list of product attributes to be updated. Example: `"title,salePrice"`. Attributes specified in the update mask without a value specified in the body will be deleted from the product. *You must specify the update mask to delete attributes.* Only top-level product attributes can be updated. If not defined, product attributes with set values will be updated and other attributes will stay unchanged. Only defined if the method is `update`.|

Represents a promotion. See the following articles for more details. * [Promotions feed specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/2906014) * [Local promotions feed specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/10146130) * [Promotions on Buy on Google product data specification](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9173673)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|brand|[string]|false|none|Product filter by brand for the promotion.|
|brandExclusion|[string]|false|none|Product filter by brand exclusion for the promotion.|
|contentLanguage|string|false|none|Required. The content language used as part of the unique identifier. `en` content language is available for all target countries. `fr` content language is available for `CA` and `FR` target countries. `de` content language is available for `DE` target country. `nl` content language is available for `NL` target country. `it` content language is available for `IT` target country. `pt` content language is available for `BR` target country. `ja` content language is available for `JP` target country. `ko` content language is available for `KR` target country.|
|couponValueType|string|false|none|Required. Coupon value type for the promotion.|
|freeGiftDescription|string|false|none|Free gift description for the promotion.|
|freeGiftItemId|string|false|none|Free gift item ID for the promotion.|
|freeGiftValue|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Free gift value for the promotion.|
|genericRedemptionCode|string|false|none|Generic redemption code for the promotion. To be used with the `offerType` field.|
|getThisQuantityDiscounted|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of items discounted in the promotion.|
|id|string|false|read-only|Required. Output only. The REST promotion ID to uniquely identify the promotion. Content API methods that operate on promotions take this as their `promotionId` parameter. The REST ID for a promotion is of the form channel:contentLanguage:targetCountry:promotionId The `channel` field has a value of `"online"`, `"in_store"`, or `"online_in_store"`.|
|itemGroupId|[string]|false|none|Product filter by item group ID for the promotion.|
|itemGroupIdExclusion|[string]|false|none|Product filter by item group ID exclusion for the promotion.|
|itemId|[string]|false|none|Product filter by item ID for the promotion.|
|itemIdExclusion|[string]|false|none|Product filter by item ID exclusion for the promotion.|
|limitQuantity|integer(int32)|false|none|Maximum purchase quantity for the promotion.|
|limitValue|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Maximum purchase value for the promotion.|
|longTitle|string|false|none|Required. Long title for the promotion.|
|minimumPurchaseAmount|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Minimum purchase amount for the promotion.|
|minimumPurchaseQuantity|integer(int32)|false|none|Minimum purchase quantity for the promotion.|
|moneyBudget|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Cost cap for the promotion.|
|moneyOffAmount|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|The money off amount offered in the promotion.|
|offerType|string|false|none|Required. Type of the promotion.|
|orderLimit|integer(int32)|false|none|Order limit for the promotion.|
|percentOff|integer(int32)|false|none|The percentage discount offered in the promotion.|
|productApplicability|string|false|none|Required. Applicability of the promotion to either all products or only specific products.|
|productType|[string]|false|none|Product filter by product type for the promotion.|
|productTypeExclusion|[string]|false|none|Product filter by product type exclusion for the promotion.|
|promotionDestinationIds|[string]|false|none|Destination ID for the promotion.|
|promotionDisplayDates|string|false|none|String representation of the promotion display dates. Deprecated. Use `promotion_display_time_period` instead.|
|promotionDisplayTimePeriod|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod)|false|none|`TimePeriod` representation of the promotion's display dates.|
|promotionEffectiveDates|string|false|none|String representation of the promotion effective dates. Deprecated. Use `promotion_effective_time_period` instead.|
|promotionEffectiveTimePeriod|[TimePeriod](#schematimeperiod)|false|none|Required. `TimePeriod` representation of the promotion's effective dates.|
|promotionId|string|false|none|Required. The user provided promotion ID to uniquely identify the promotion.|
|promotionStatus|[PromotionPromotionStatus](#schemapromotionpromotionstatus)|false|none|Output only. The current status of the promotion.|
|promotionUrl|string|false|none|URL to the page on the merchant's site where the promotion shows. Local Inventory ads promotions throw an error if no promo url is included. URL is used to confirm that the promotion is valid and can be redeemed.|
|redemptionChannel|[string]|false|none|Required. Redemption channel for the promotion. At least one channel is required.|
|shippingServiceNames|[string]|false|none|Shipping service names for the promotion.|
|storeApplicability|string|false|none|Whether the promotion applies to all stores, or only specified stores. Local Inventory ads promotions throw an error if no store applicability is included. An INVALID_ARGUMENT error is thrown if store_applicability is set to ALL_STORES and store_code or score_code_exclusion is set to a value.|
|storeCode|[string]|false|none|Store codes to include for the promotion.|
|storeCodeExclusion|[string]|false|none|Store codes to exclude for the promotion.|
|targetCountry|string|false|none|Required. The target country used as part of the unique identifier. Can be `AU`, `CA`, `DE`, `FR`, `GB`, `IN`, `US`, `BR`, `ES`, `NL`, `JP`, `IT` or `KR`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|couponValueType|COUPON_VALUE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|couponValueType|MONEY_OFF|
|couponValueType|PERCENT_OFF|
|couponValueType|BUY_M_GET_N_MONEY_OFF|

```json
    }
  ],
```

```json
    "uri": "string"
  },

  "paid": true,
  "recommendationName": "string",

  "title": "string",
  "type": "string"
}
```

Recommendations are suggested ways to improve your merchant account's performance. For example, to engage with a feature, or start using a new Google product.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additionalCallToAction|[[RecommendationCallToAction](#schemarecommendationcalltoaction)]|false|read-only|Output only. CTAs of this recommendation. Repeated.|
|additionalDescriptions|[[RecommendationDescription](#schemarecommendationdescription)]|false|read-only|Output only. List of additional localized descriptions for a recommendation. Localication uses the `languageCode` field in `GenerateRecommendations` requests. Not all description types are guaranteed to be present and we recommend to rely on default description.|
|creative|[[RecommendationCreative](#schemarecommendationcreative)]|false|read-only|Output only. Any creatives attached to the recommendation. Repeated.|
|defaultCallToAction|[RecommendationCallToAction](#schemarecommendationcalltoaction)|false|none|Optional. Default CTA of the recommendation.|
|defaultDescription|string|false|none|Optional. Localized recommendation description. The localization the {@link `GenerateRecommendationsRequest.language_code`} field in {@link `GenerateRecommendationsRequest`} requests.|
|numericalImpact|integer(int32)|false|none|Optional. A numerical score of the impact from the recommendation's description. For example, a recommendation might suggest an upward trend in sales for a certain product. Higher number means larger impact.|
|paid|boolean|false|none|Optional. Indicates whether a user needs to pay when they complete the user journey suggested by the recommendation.|
|recommendationName|string|false|none|Optional. Localized recommendation name. The localization uses the {@link `GenerateRecommendationsRequest.language_code`} field in {@link `GenerateRecommendationsRequest`} requests.|
|subType|string|false|none|Optional. Subtype of the recommendations. Only applicable when multiple recommendations can be generated per type, and is used as an identifier of recommendation under the same recommendation type.|
|title|string|false|none|Optional. Localized Recommendation Title. Localization uses the {@link `GenerateRecommendationsRequest.language_code`} field in {@link `GenerateRecommendationsRequest`} requests.|
|type|string|false|read-only|Output only. Type of the recommendation. List of currently available recommendation types: - OPPORTUNITY_CREATE_NEW_COLLECTION - OPPORTUNITY_CREATE_EMAIL_CAMPAIGN|

<h2 id="tocS_RecommendationCallToAction">RecommendationCallToAction</h2>

Call to action (CTA) that explains how a merchant can implement this recommendation

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|intent|string|false|read-only|Output only. Intent of the action. This value describes the intent (for example, `OPEN_CREATE_EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_FLOW`) and can vary from recommendation to recommendation. This value can change over time for the same recommendation. Currently available intent values: - OPEN_CREATE_EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_FLOW: Opens a user journey where they can create a marketing email campaign. (No default URL) - OPEN_CREATE_COLLECTION_TAB: Opens a user journey where they can [create a collection](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9703228) for their Merchant account. (No default URL)|
|localizedText|string|false|read-only|Output only. Localized text of the CTA. Optional.|
|uri|string|false|none|Optional. URL of the CTA. This field will only be set for some recommendations where there is a suggested landing URL. Otherwise it will be set to an empty string. We recommend developers to use their own custom landing page according to the description of the intent field above when this uri field is empty.|

<h2 id="tocS_RepricingProductReport">RepricingProductReport</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarepricingproductreport"></a>
<a id="schema_RepricingProductReport"></a>
<a id="tocSrepricingproductreport"></a>
<a id="tocsrepricingproductreport"></a>

```json
{
  "applicationCount": "string",
  "buyboxWinningProductStats": {
    "buyboxWinsCount": 0
  },
  "date": {
    "day": 0,
    "month": 0,
    "year": 0
  },
  "highWatermark": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "inapplicabilityDetails": [
    {
      "inapplicableCount": "string",
      "inapplicableReason": "INAPPLICABLE_REASON_UNSPECIFIED"
    }
  ],
  "lowWatermark": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "orderItemCount": 0,
  "ruleIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "totalGmv": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "type": "REPRICING_RULE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED"
}
```

Resource that represents a daily Repricing product report. Each report contains stats for a single type of Repricing rule for a single product on a given day. If there are multiple rules of the same type for the product on that day, the report lists all the rules by rule ids, combines the stats, and paginates the results by date. To retrieve the stats of a particular rule, provide the rule_id in the request.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|applicationCount|string(int64)|false|none|Total count of Repricer applications. This value captures how many times the rule of this type was applied to this product during this reporting period.|
|buyboxWinningProductStats|[RepricingProductReportBuyboxWinningProductStats](#schemarepricingproductreportbuyboxwinningproductstats)|false|none|Stats specific to buybox winning rules for product report (deprecated).|
|date|[Date](#schemadate)|false|none|Date of the stats in this report. The report starts and ends according to the merchant's timezone.|
|highWatermark|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Maximum displayed price after repriced during this reporting period.|
|inapplicabilityDetails|[[InapplicabilityDetails](#schemainapplicabilitydetails)]|false|none|List of all reasons the rule did not apply to the product during the specified reporting period.|
|lowWatermark|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Minimum displayed price after repriced during this reporting period.|
|orderItemCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Total unit count of impacted products ordered while the rule was active on the date of the report. This count includes all orders that were started while the rule was active, even if the rule was no longer active when the order was completed.|
|ruleIds|[string]|false|none|Ids of the Repricing rule for this report.|
|totalGmv|[PriceAmount](#schemapriceamount)|false|none|Total GMV generated by impacted products while the rule was active on the date of the report. This value includes all orders that were started while the rule was active, even if the rule was no longer active when the order was completed.|
|type|string|false|none|Type of the rule.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|REPRICING_RULE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|type|TYPE_STATS_BASED|
|type|TYPE_COGS_BASED|
|type|TYPE_SALES_VOLUME_BASED|
|type|TYPE_COMPETITIVE_PRICE|

|restriction|[RepricingRuleRestriction](#schemarepricingrulerestriction)|false|none|Required. Restriction of the rule appliance.|
|ruleId|string|false|read-only|Output only. Immutable. The ID to uniquely identify each repricing rule.|
|statsBasedRule|[RepricingRuleStatsBasedRule](#schemarepricingrulestatsbasedrule)|false|none|The rule definition for TYPE_STATS_BASED. Required when the rule type is TYPE_STATS_BASED.|
|title|string|false|none|The title for the rule.|
|type|string|false|none|Required. Immutable. The type of the rule.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|

|type|TYPE_COGS_BASED|

<h2 id="tocS_RepricingRuleEligibleOfferMatcher">RepricingRuleEligibleOfferMatcher</h2>

```json
    "strAttributes": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "itemGroupIdMatcher": {
    "strAttributes": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "matcherOption": "MATCHER_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED",
  "offerIdMatcher": {
    "strAttributes": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "skipWhenOnPromotion": true
}
```

Matcher that specifies eligible offers. When the USE_FEED_ATTRIBUTE option is selected, only the repricing_rule_id attribute on the product feed is used to specify offer-rule mapping. When the CUSTOM_FILTER option is selected, only the *_matcher fields are used to filter the offers for offer-rule mapping. If the CUSTOM_FILTER option is selected, an offer needs to satisfy each custom filter matcher to be eligible for a rule. Size limit: the sum of the number of entries in all the matchers should not exceed 20. For example, there can be 15 product ids and 5 brands, but not 10 product ids and 11 brands.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|brandMatcher|[RepricingRuleEligibleOfferMatcherStringMatcher](#schemarepricingruleeligibleoffermatcherstringmatcher)|false|none|Filter by the brand.|
|itemGroupIdMatcher|[RepricingRuleEligibleOfferMatcherStringMatcher](#schemarepricingruleeligibleoffermatcherstringmatcher)|false|none|Filter by the item group id.|
|matcherOption|string|false|none|Determines whether to use the custom matchers or the product feed attribute "repricing_rule_id" to specify offer-rule mapping.|
|offerIdMatcher|[RepricingRuleEligibleOfferMatcherStringMatcher](#schemarepricingruleeligibleoffermatcherstringmatcher)|false|none|Filter by the offer id.|
|skipWhenOnPromotion|boolean|false|none|When true, the rule won't be applied to offers with active promotions.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|matcherOption|MATCHER_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED|
|matcherOption|MATCHER_OPTION_CUSTOM_FILTER|
|matcherOption|MATCHER_OPTION_USE_FEED_ATTRIBUTE|
|matcherOption|MATCHER_OPTION_ALL_PRODUCTS|

<h2 id="tocS_RepricingRuleRestriction">RepricingRuleRestriction</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarepricingrulerestriction"></a>
<a id="schema_RepricingRuleRestriction"></a>
<a id="tocSrepricingrulerestriction"></a>
<a id="tocsrepricingrulerestriction"></a>

```json
{
  "floor": {
    "percentageDelta": 0,
    "priceDelta": "string"
  },
  "useAutoPricingMinPrice": true
}
```

Definition of a rule restriction. At least one of the following needs to be true: (1) use_auto_pricing_min_price is true (2) floor.price_delta exists (3) floor.percentage_delta exists If floor.price_delta and floor.percentage_delta are both set on a rule, the highest value will be chosen by the Repricer. In other words, for a product with a price of $50, if the `floor.percentage_delta` is "-10" and the floor.price_delta is "-12", the offer price will only be lowered $5 (10% lower than the original offer price).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|floor|[RepricingRuleRestrictionBoundary](#schemarepricingrulerestrictionboundary)|false|none|The inclusive floor lower bound. The repricing rule only applies when new price >= floor.|
|useAutoPricingMinPrice|boolean|false|none|If true, use the AUTO_PRICING_MIN_PRICE offer attribute as the lower bound of the rule. If use_auto_pricing_min_price is true, then only offers with `AUTO_PRICING_MIN_PRICE` existing on the offer will get Repricer treatment, even if a floor value is set on the rule. Also, if use_auto_pricing_min_price is true, the floor restriction will be ignored.|

<h2 id="tocS_RepricingRuleRestrictionBoundary">RepricingRuleRestrictionBoundary</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarepricingrulerestrictionboundary"></a>
<a id="schema_RepricingRuleRestrictionBoundary"></a>
<a id="tocSrepricingrulerestrictionboundary"></a>
<a id="tocsrepricingrulerestrictionboundary"></a>

```json
{
  "percentageDelta": 0,
  "priceDelta": "string"
}
```

Definition of a boundary.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|percentageDelta|integer(int32)|false|none|The percentage delta relative to the offer selling price. This field is signed. It must be negative in floor. When it is used in floor, it should be > -100. For example, if an offer is selling at $10 and this field is -30 in floor, the repricing rule only applies if the calculated new price is >= $7.|
|priceDelta|string|false|none|The price micros relative to the offer selling price. This field is signed. It must be negative in floor. For example, if an offer is selling at $10 and this field is -$2 in floor, the repricing rule only applies if the calculated new price is >= $8.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|totalRefundedAmount|[MonetaryAmount](#schemamonetaryamount)|false|none|Total amount already refunded by the merchant. It includes all types of refunds (items, shipping, etc.) Not provided if no refund has been applied yet.|

Dimensions according to which metrics are segmented in the response. Values of product dimensions, such as `offer_id`, reflect the state of a product at the time of the corresponding event, for example, impression or order. Segment fields cannot be selected in queries without also selecting at least one metric field. Values are only set for dimensions requested explicitly in the request's search query.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|brand|string|false|none|Brand of the product.|
|categoryL1|string|false|none|[Product category (1st level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL2|string|false|none|[Product category (2nd level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL3|string|false|none|[Product category (3rd level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL4|string|false|none|[Product category (4th level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in Google's product taxonomy.|
|categoryL5|string|false|none|[Product category (5th level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in Google's product taxonomy.|
|currencyCode|string|false|none|Currency in which price metrics are represented, for example, if you select `ordered_item_sales_micros`, the returned value will be represented by this currency.|
|customLabel0|string|false|none|Custom label 0 for custom grouping of products.|
|customLabel1|string|false|none|Custom label 1 for custom grouping of products.|
|customLabel2|string|false|none|Custom label 2 for custom grouping of products.|
|customLabel3|string|false|none|Custom label 3 for custom grouping of products.|
|customLabel4|string|false|none|Custom label 4 for custom grouping of products.|
|customerCountryCode|string|false|none|Code of the country where the customer is located at the time of the event. Represented in the ISO 3166 format. If the customer country cannot be determined, a special 'ZZ' code is returned.|
|date|[Date](#schemadate)|false|none|Date in the merchant timezone to which metrics apply.|
|offerId|string|false|none|Merchant-provided id of the product.|
|productTypeL1|string|false|none|[Product type (1st level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in merchant's own product taxonomy.|
|productTypeL2|string|false|none|[Product type (2nd level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in merchant's own product taxonomy.|
|productTypeL3|string|false|none|[Product type (3rd level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in merchant's own product taxonomy.|
|productTypeL4|string|false|none|[Product type (4th level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in merchant's own product taxonomy.|
|productTypeL5|string|false|none|[Product type (5th level)](https://developers.google.com/shopping-content/guides/reports/segmentation#category_and_product_type) in merchant's own product taxonomy.|
|program|string|false|none|Program to which metrics apply, for example, Free Product Listing.|
|title|string|false|none|Title of the product.|
|week|[Date](#schemadate)|false|none|First day of the week (Monday) of the metrics date in the merchant timezone.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|program|PROGRAM_UNSPECIFIED|
|program|SHOPPING_ADS|
|program|FREE_PRODUCT_LISTING|
|program|FREE_LOCAL_PRODUCT_LISTING|
|program|BUY_ON_GOOGLE_LISTING|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|active|boolean|false|none|A boolean exposing the active status of the shipping service. Required.|
|currency|string|false|none|The CLDR code of the currency to which this service applies. Must match that of the prices in rate groups.|
|deliveryCountry|string|false|none|The CLDR territory code of the country to which the service applies. Required.|
|deliveryTime|[DeliveryTime](#schemadeliverytime)|false|none|Time spent in various aspects from order to the delivery of the product. Required.|
|eligibility|string|false|none|Eligibility for this service. Acceptable values are: - "`All scenarios`" - "`All scenarios except Shopping Actions`" - "`Shopping Actions`" |
|minimumOrderValue|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|Minimum order value for this service. If set, indicates that customers will have to spend at least this amount. All prices within a service must have the same currency. Cannot be set together with minimum_order_value_table.|
|minimumOrderValueTable|[MinimumOrderValueTable](#schemaminimumordervaluetable)|false|none|Table of per store minimum order values for the pickup fulfillment type. Cannot be set together with minimum_order_value.|
|name|string|false|none|Free-form name of the service. Must be unique within target account. Required.|
|pickupService|[PickupCarrierService](#schemapickupcarrierservice)|false|none|The carrier-service pair delivering items to collection points. The list of supported pickup services can be retrieved through the `getSupportedPickupServices` method. Required if and only if the service delivery type is `pickup`.|
|rateGroups|[[RateGroup](#schemarategroup)]|false|none|Shipping rate group definitions. Only the last one is allowed to have an empty `applicableShippingLabels`, which means "everything else". The other `applicableShippingLabels` must not overlap.|
|shipmentType|string|false|none|Type of locations this service ships orders to. Acceptable values are: - "`delivery`" - "`pickup`" |

|transferAmount|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|The money due to the merchant.|
|transferDate|string|false|none|Date on which transfer for this payment was initiated by Google, in ISO 8601 format.|
|transferIds|[string]|false|none|The list of bank identifiers used for the transfer. For example, Trace ID for Federal Automated Clearing House (ACH). This may also be known as the Wire ID.|

### Properties

|---|---|---|---|---|

|services|[[Service](#schemaservice)]|false|none|The target account's list of services. Optional.|
|warehouses|[[Warehouse](#schemawarehouse)]|false|none|Optional. A list of warehouses which can be referred to in `services`.|

A batch entry encoding a single non-batch shippingsettings request.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the account for which to get/update account shipping settings.|
|batchId|integer(uint32)|false|none|An entry ID, unique within the batch request.|
|merchantId|string(uint64)|false|none|The ID of the managing account.|
|method|string|false|none|The method of the batch entry. Acceptable values are: - "`get`" - "`update`" |
|shippingSettings|[ShippingSettings](#schemashippingsettings)|false|none|The account shipping settings to update. Only defined if the method is `update`.|

|shippingSettings|[ShippingSettings](#schemashippingsettings)|false|none|The retrieved or updated account shipping settings.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|disapprovalDate|string|false|none|Date by which eligibilityStatus will go from `WARNING` to `DISAPPROVED`. Only visible when your eligibilityStatus is WARNING. In [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.|
|eligibilityStatus|string|false|none|Eligibility status of the Shopping Ads program.|
|onboardingIssues|[string]|false|none|Issues that must be fixed to be eligible for review.|
|regionCodes|[string]|false|none|The two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) codes for all the regions with the same `eligibilityStatus` and `reviewEligibility`.|
|reviewEligibilityStatus|string|false|none|If a program is eligible for review in a specific region. Only visible if `eligibilityStatus` is `DISAPPROVED`.|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|string|false|none|Review ineligibility reason if account is not eligible for review.|
|reviewIneligibilityReasonDescription|string|false|none|Reason a program in a specific region isn’t eligible for review. Only visible if `reviewEligibilityStatus` is `INELIGIBLE`.|
|reviewIneligibilityReasonDetails|[ShoppingAdsProgramStatusReviewIneligibilityReasonDetails](#schemashoppingadsprogramstatusreviewineligibilityreasondetails)|false|none|Additional information for ineligibility. If `reviewIneligibilityReason` is `IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD`, a timestamp for the end of the cooldown period is provided.|
|reviewIssues|[string]|false|none|Issues evaluated in the review process. Fix all issues before requesting a review.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|eligibilityStatus|APPROVED|
|eligibilityStatus|DISAPPROVED|
|eligibilityStatus|WARNING|
|eligibilityStatus|UNDER_REVIEW|
|eligibilityStatus|PENDING_REVIEW|
|eligibilityStatus|ONBOARDING|
|reviewEligibilityStatus|REVIEW_ELIGIBILITY_UNSPECIFIED|
|reviewEligibilityStatus|ELIGIBLE|
|reviewEligibilityStatus|INELIGIBLE|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|REVIEW_INELIGIBILITY_REASON_UNSPECIFIED|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|ONBOARDING_ISSUES|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|NOT_ENOUGH_OFFERS|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|IN_COOLDOWN_PERIOD|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|ALREADY_UNDER_REVIEW|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|NO_REVIEW_REQUIRED|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|WILL_BE_REVIEWED_AUTOMATICALLY|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|IS_RETIRED|
|reviewIneligibilityReason|ALREADY_REVIEWED|

<h2 id="tocS_Value">Value</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemavalue"></a>
<a id="schema_Value"></a>
<a id="tocSvalue"></a>
<a id="tocsvalue"></a>

```json
{
  "carrierRateName": "string",
  "flatRate": {
    "currency": "string",
    "value": "string"
  },
  "noShipping": true,
  "pricePercentage": "string",
  "subtableName": "string"
}
```

The single value of a rate group or the value of a rate group table's cell. Exactly one of `noShipping`, `flatRate`, `pricePercentage`, `carrierRateName`, `subtableName` must be set.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|carrierRateName|string|false|none|The name of a carrier rate referring to a carrier rate defined in the same rate group. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|flatRate|[Price](#schemaprice)|false|none|A flat rate. Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|noShipping|boolean|false|none|If true, then the product can't ship. Must be true when set, can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|pricePercentage|string|false|none|A percentage of the price represented as a number in decimal notation (for example, `"5.4"`). Can only be set if all other fields are not set.|
|subtableName|string|false|none|The name of a subtable. Can only be set in table cells (not for single values), and only if all other fields are not set.|
